Overview [ ] 
The Administrative Affairs Department is the highest decision-making body in Roscaelifer, led by Eldreda Sunbringer . It establishes regulations, coordinates operations across all precincts, and directs the overall functioning of Roscaelifer. [ 1 ]

The Airspace Patrol Department (A.P.D.) , full name Roscaelifer Airspace Patrol Department , often shortened to Airspace Patrol , is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . It is one of the Five Central Departments of Roscaelifer .

Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across Roscaelifer departments are considered to belong in one faction. This is known because Ultra Jake 's Additional Ability description states that the ability activates if there are Roscaelifer Agents in the squad, but it is not restricted to specifically External Strategy Department Agents, for example.
Description [ ] 
The Airspace Patrol is responsible for maintaining the security of Roscaelifer and its surrounding airspace, being the primary force that contends with the Ethereals of Scamall Hollow . It is led by Lindverne Sunbringer , with Sigrid de L'Azur serving as her second in command. [ 1 ] The position of second in command has been held by the de L'Azur family for successive generations, with Sigrid's mother and grandmother both holding the position, while Lindverne is the only known individual to have led Airspace Patrol.
Combatboo are the primary Bangboo utilised by Airspace Patrol, with many of them wielding mechs such as the Airspace Patrolboo , Special Anti-Riotboo and City Guardboo .

01
Dance Duet
"Get your work done, or you're in for a beating!" is how Drusilla tries to encourage everyone.
"Yeah, a beating!" Anastella always chimes in.
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The buff gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130%.
02
Master's Paragon
"It takes an excellent head maid to lead excellent maids, and an exemplary master to raise exemplary Bangboo." — Excerpt from Rina's speech at the "Victoria Housekeeping Human Resource Management and Bangboo Training Insight Seminar."
Upon entering combat or switching in, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
03
Head Maid's Specialty
Rina always has the confidence to excel at anything and the ability to annihilate everything.
However, when it comes to being in the mood to annihilate enemies, both her confidence and capability align.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Needle and Hammer
Drusilla and Anastella can never agree on anything.
"Beating up the dummy in front" is an exception.
Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed.
The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.
05
Head Maid Perfectionist
"Rina" means perfection in the Bangboo language.
Perfectionism is the number one rule in the Victoria Housekeeping handbook.
And Rina has her own criteria for judging "perfection."
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv.+2
06
Stormy Night's Fright
Thunder rumbles in the old castle on a rainy night. The depths of the long corridors are filled with eerie shadows.
Fear circuits overloaded, the filming of a thriller commences.
When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate hits an enemy, the entire squad’s Electric DMG is increased by 15% for 8s.

Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

After any squad member inflicts a Physical Anomaly on an enemy, Alice deals additional DMG each 0.95s of its active duration, equal to 2.5% of the original Physical Anomaly DMG. When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz lands, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarized Assault , dealing 100% of the original Assault DMG, ignoring Anomaly Buildup progress. This can be combined with any Attribute Anomaly, including Physical Anomaly, to trigger Disorder .

01
Palmful of Cilantro
A sprig of coriander sways like a newborn green star,
So fragile her fingertips felt they might pass through it.
She slowly opened her trembling hands,
And held that flicker of feeling in her palms.
Her heart beat like a spring bud breaking the earth at dawn, just after the rain.
When Alice triggers a Polarized Assault , she gains 25 Blade Etiquette .
When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.
02
Sage at the Sword's Tip
The silver blade dips low, kissing the frost-lined sage leaf.
This pre-battle salute is the girl's quiet show of composure.
Fear and helplessness lie frozen in the faded dreams of yesterday.
Her sword stirs, ready to trace the outline of the stars.
Dawn is near, and the flower bud waits to bloom.
When Ultimate: Starfall Finale' s Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarized Assault .
All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomaly increases by 15%.
Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
03
Symmetrism
She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

04
Rosemary on Her Lips
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."
Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES .
Enhanced Basic Attack: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomaly Buildup .
05
Passion for the Supernatural
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.
"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
A Heart of Thyme
The thyme-scented manor,
The night spent watching the stars,
The moment she came to understand what courage truly meant.
A fragrant wind swept the clouds away, and sunlight outshone the crystal chandelier.
The girl gave a gentle bow to the days gone by.
Then, slowly, she vanished into the field of thyme.
When Alice uses a third-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz or Ultimate: Starfall Finale , she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.

Mindscape Cinema [ ]

Toggle Text 
01
Rapid Charge Mode
"Charge up for just a minute, and you're set to fight for an hour!" That's the sales pitch for these weapon expansion modules. And they deliver exactly that.
When the 4th-hit of Anby's Basic Attack hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.
02
Precision Discharge
"Electric shocks will knock you out cold." Looking at the enemy out cold at her feet, she added: "At least, that's what happens in the movies."
When Basic Attack: Thunderbolt hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's EX Special Attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.
03
Well-Desciplined
Run, slash, move like thunder. She is no amateur when it comes to Hollows, but an expert in the trade.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Conducting Charge
You won't last long fighting solo. An experienced Hollow Raider knows how to create opportunities for their teammates.
When Anby launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, off-field Electric characters recover 3 Energy. For every 12% of Anby's Energy Generation Rate, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6 additional Energy.
05
Street Experience
Not only can working for the Cunning Hares improve your mental fortitude, but it will also help (read: force) you to improve your constitution.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Charging Field
Coils of electricity flickered over her fingertips. Anby raised her head, eyes brimming with determination beyond her years. Perhaps, one day, she will be the one with total mastery over electricity.
When Anby uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her Basic Attack or Dash Attack, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.

[Post] The Angels of Delusion rising star journey officially kicks off! 
Hey everyone! We're the idol group Angels of Delusion, and we're SO excited to be performing on the New Eridu's Rising Star stage—
We can't believe it... we'll be meeting you all so soon on our first livestream!
We're a bit nervous, a little overwhelmed, and our hearts race when we face the camera... but whenever we think about how we'll see the excited faces of our Delulus once recording starts, we're filled with anticipation...
Sunna once said... "delusion" always arrives when you least expect it. It shines brighter than starlight, more dazzling than even the sun...
And what we need to do is run forward, immerse ourselves in that delusion, and show everyone the best versions of ourselves... without holding anything back!
From now on, we'll be using this account to share our daily lives, livestream performances, and... everything we want to tell you all!
We hope you'll stick with us, journey together with us into the realm of music and delusion—
All the possibilities leading to the future, starting from this ray of light.
Ah, we got carried away...
So then, please enjoy the very first livestream performance from the Angels of Delusion just for you! Cheer us on, okay~ (≧▽≦)
[Post] Today's dose of 'delusion,' for all you Delulus out there! 
Today's song is an Angels of Delusion original! Hope you all enjoy!
Oh, and today's drink rec? Tin Master's Mochaccino!
It smells like... sweet creamy goodness, with this syrupy bubbly aroma... On a cold winter day, just holding one in your hands warms up your joints and lifts your spirits—
We hope our music can give you that same warm, cozy feeling as a Mochaccino...
[Post] Final recording stream, thanks for all the support, everyone! 
Finally... it's the last day of recording.
I'm still a bit nervous, but standing here in front of the stage, for some reason... I realize we're ready. Our hearts are ready for this stage.
As we move forward, we'll hold each other's hands and keep running, keep singing our hearts out...
One day, the Angels of Delusion will stand on an even bigger stage, and our voices will reach every corner of New Eridu—
This song... is for everyone who dares to have delusions! Thank you all!

Trivia [ ] 
In the Virtual Battlefield Mayhem Event of Version 1.3 - Virtual Revenge , the Intelligent Construct who got trapped in the VR system is highly likely to be Aria, not only because Astra Yao knows them, and they are under TOPS , but also because in the artwork for the event , the poster on the wall displays Aria's robot headpiece.
Furthermore, in the Muse's Holiday commission of Angels and Delusions of Muse , Aria talks to the protagonist about an online friend that she wants to give a gift to. When the protagonist suggests that they go to Fantasy Resort to find inspiration, Aria comments that Fantasy Resort strongly reminds her of the online friend. This most likely alludes to Astra's appearance and performance in Midsummer Fantasy: Fantasy Music Festival! .
If Astra was indeed the online friend, that would mean that after the events of Virtual Battlefield Mayhem , Aria probably reached out and befriended Astra online (as ChaoticFriedRice, most likely).
Astra probably would have have also told Aria online about her concert at Fantasy Resort, or else Aria would know who her online friend is in person.
Dialogue with "Harley" at Reverb Arena reveals:
The Angels livestream quite often.
They are still an "underground band" and not as popular as Astra Yao .
Dialogue with the "Confused Girl" at Starloop reveals:
The Leader is a "girl with a hint of pink at the tips of her hair" (revealed to be Nangong Yu).
There are rumours suggesting the Leader and Composer do not get along that well.
There are rumours that at least one of the members is a "crybaby" and cries on livestreams (revealed to be Sunna).
Dialogue with the "Downcast Lady" at Starloop reveals:
The group is still far from being considered popular.
Interacting with "An Elegant Trash Can" in Starloop's VIP Lounge will reveal that someone threw away a "painstakingly composed" piece of sheet music, either out of spite, or because it wasn't good enough.
They have an active social media presence:
They have an official social media account named @AOD_EN_Official , which is present on X (formerly known as Twitter), YouTube, and Bilibili.
Their fans are called "Delulus."
There is an official fanart tag for the Angels of Delusions named #ArtofDelusion.

Toggle Text 
01
Warm-Up Exercises
"Are you awake? Get spinning, bro!"
"Try and keep up. It's time to do our stretches!"
When Drill Attack hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
02
State of Flow
After arduous training, a few lucky individuals will display exceptional vigor and perform above their usual level during high-intensity activities, entering a state of flow commonly known as "being in the zone."
Are you ready to get moving and enter the zone?
— Nitro-Fuel's exclusive program "Good Morning, Zealous Office Workers!"
When Anton uses his EX Special Attack and enters Burst Mode, he gains a Shield that equals to 7.5% of his max HP. While in Burst Mode, entering combat or switching in reapplies the Shield effect. This effect can trigger once every 15s. The Shield dissipates when Burst Mode ends.
03
Rotational Training
Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but in a complex and ever-changing Hollow worksite, having a wide skillset can present an opportunity to overcome difficulties.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Everyone Get Fired Up!
"Find your rhythm, and let's get moving!"
When Anton starts to get serious, everyone becomes more nimble.
They have to keep up or else they will be training alone the next day.
When Anton uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, all squad members' CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 12s.
05
Jack of All Trades
Knowing a bit of everything may seem underwhelming, but if you are resolute enough to change from "knowing a bit" to "being excellent," then you become omnipotent!
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Break the Limit
"Yeah bro, can you feel the burn?"
Whenever Anton wants to exceed his limits, his "bro" starts spinning at an astonishing pace, its buzzing echoing Anton's resolution.
When Anton's Piledriver Attack triggers a critical hit, his Basic Attack: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode) and Dodge Counter: Overload Drill (Burst Mode) deal 4% more DMG for 30s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch 
Basic Attack 
Hold to activate:
Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ether DMG .
If there is Fandom Power nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the Fandom Power , with each absorbed Fandom Power instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch' s Ether Anomaly Buildup by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody , Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice , an EX Special Attack , the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch , a Quick Assist , a Chain Attack , or an Ultimate , if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, hold to consume 2 Fandom Power and quickly activate the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch . After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch , a Chain Attack , or an Ultimate , if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch can also be quickly activated by pressing within a short window, consuming 2 Fandom Power .
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this attack.

01
Energetic Sound Waves
"You see them? Everyone out there is waiting for us. So when the lights come up, we have to be full of energy. That's what it means to be an idol."
—A few whispered words before going on stage.
When Aria's Basic Attack , Special Attack , or EX Special Attack deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomaly Buildup RES .
Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom , it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
02
Fantastical Beat
"We don't have to sing it yet. Just close our eyes, feel it, and accept it. Then, on stage, through our performance, we'll make the whole audience fall in love with it."
When Aria attacks or triggers Abloom , it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During Moment of Delusion , attacks and Abloom triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.
03
Delulu
"Whether it's a dream or just a delusion, we just need to keep running toward a better version of ourselves. Everyone is worthy of being appreciated, and every effort will be remembered by someone."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Mechanical Angel
My wings are moonlight forged from tempered steel,
with lines of code, each vibration made real.
Gears bite into the rhythm of destiny,
while silent electricity roars through me.
When Aria triggers Abloom , she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
05
Tears in the Rain
I once saw a city swallowed by the Hollows, its order reshaped by Ether. Everything beautiful was consumed by darkness, sinking into the long river of time... like tears fading in the rain.

Construct's Dream
Do you still remember that night in September, when love was born?
Do you still remember the dancing on the stage, in those days when we fell into delusions?

Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya 
Basic Attack 
When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer / EX Special Attack / Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers . If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers . This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather , the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather , dealing Electric DMG .
Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison , they will be X-Marked .

Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash 
Dodge 
Dash Attack 
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash .
While in the Awakened state, press during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG .
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison . With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison , X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash . While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash .
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

01
"High Spirit"
"I'm not like some stubborn idiots who insist on facing the enemy head-on."

02
Languish
"Don't look at me like that, I'm actually real frail, y'know~"
Harumasa lazily sprawls across his office desk.
"So... how 'bout picking someone else for this mission?"
When using an Chain Attack or Ultimate , Harumasa gains 7 stacks of Electro Blitz , up to a max of 7 stacks.
While possessing Electro Blitz , the DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 50%.
Consume 1 stack of Electro Blitz once Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash ends.
03
White Lies

Idyllic Cadenza 
Special Attack 
After entering the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by X% and CRIT DMG by Y% .
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing will activate Basic Attack: Interlude , and pressing will activate a dodge. After triggering a Perfect Dodge , press to activate Basic Attack: Chorus .
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths" .
During this state, hold to activate Basic Attack: Finale , exiting the Idyllic Cadenza state, or hold to exit the Idyllic Cadenza state directly.
For Skill Scalings "Squad DMG Increase" ( X% ) and "Squad CRIT DMG Increase" ( Y% ), refer to Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths" .

12-Tone Equal Temperament
"What is the 12-tone equal temperament?"
"12-tone equal temperament is a musical tuning system, just like how children have to line up, sounds need to be in order too."
"But sounds probably don't like lining up, just like children!"
—Astra Yao's music teacher, recalling when she was six.

02
Art of Greed
"The shiniest thing in the world is, of course, love!"
Just like a bird gathering shiny things for its nest, an artist's inner greed is probably to gather all the love in the world. By gathering all the love, one can create the most beautiful melody.

Interwoven Staff Notation
A blank musical staff is a set of parallel lines that never intersect, like souls that have never met, quietly waiting for their melodies to intertwine into a song.
"Let's fill it with notes! And lots and lots of tied notes. It'll make a fantastic song!"
And that's how a new song was created, stretching across 136 bars, all connected with ties...

Banyue ( -Rank,  Fire ,  Rupture ) is a playable Agent in Zenless Zone Zero , and one of the Judges [ 5 ] of the   Krampus Compliance Authority . He is addressed as Shifu ( Chinese : 师父 shīfu , "master" ) by his disciples.

Basic Attack: Inflame 
Basic Attack 
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 Wrathful Fires , hold to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover Wrathful Fires . Upon reaching 120 Wrathful Fires , Banyue immediately enters the Visage of Wrath state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.

Core Passive: One With the Mountains 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover Wrathful Fires through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 Wrathful Fires for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon activating Defensive Assist ;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires when parrying an enemy with Dodge: Immovable Mountain , and recover 6 Wrathful Fires instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon triggering a Perfect Dodge , up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 Wrathful Fires . When he possesses at least 120 Wrathful Fires , Banyue can enter the Visage of Wrath state by using Basic Attack: Immolate . While in Visage of Wrath state, Banyue can no longer gain Wrathful Fires . After Banyue uses Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain , he exits the Visage of Wrath state.
When entering the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue gains 4 Mountain's Might . If Banyue has Mountain's Might , launching an EX Special Attack no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 Mountain's Might and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the Visage of Wrath state, remove all Mountain's Might .
When possessing Mountain's Might in Visage of Wrath state, hold to launch four different EX Special Attacks and Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an EX Special Attack or Assist Follow-Up , he increases his Sheer Force by X , Fire DMG by Y% , and CRIT DMG by Z% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

01
Greed Burns Like Fire
Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.
"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."
When Banyue hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: One's Path or EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker , he inflicts the Tremor state. In this state, enemies Fire RES is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s.
When EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar , EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath , EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor , EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath , Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain , and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits an enemy in the Tremor state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%.
When Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
02
Anger Cuts Like a Blade
The students at the martial arts school had never seen Banyue Shifu lose his temper, let alone fly into a rage. Even with the dullest or most reckless students, he seemed endlessly patient. After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.
But when it stirs with the wrath of the heavens, even the fiercest of beasts will tremble in fear.
"Anger is like a blade — keep it sheathed in daily life, lest it wound those around you."
The CRIT DMG bonus from the Core Passive is increased by an additional 15%, and the Fire DMG bonus is increased by an additional 15%.
While in the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack .
03
Ignorance Binds Like Chains
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.
"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Purge Unit - Type Zero
Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?
"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."
EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath , EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath , Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain , and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks DMG increase by 30% .
05
Student
Did you hear? There's a martial arts school up in the mountain taught by some big construct.
The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?
"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Descended Vidyaraja
"Dying's the easy way out, isn't it, big guy? You've still got a long path of redemption ahead of you!"
"This... is my final verdict!"
Her frame was delicate, yet her words landed with a weight that seemed to cut through a mountain of burden and doubt.
"I still question whether I have the wisdom and courage to judge... but that's no excuse to stop moving forward."
At any time, when Banyue uses an EX Special Attack , he also gains Vidyaraja .
The Fire DMG bonus from Vidyaraja is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s.
When activating Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks , Banyue deals Fire DMG equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies.
Using Dodge: Battle Cry immediately after an EX Special Attack also grants Vidyaraja .

Toggle Text 
01
Dazzling Entrance
"You guys are way too honest to be bad guys!"
"All lined up, like NPCs at the shooting range!"
When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.
02
Roaming Gunslinger
"The Starlight Knights never run from danger. That's what we call tactical repositioning for better aim!"
— User "Dreamgirl Monica" from the Starlight Radiance messageboards.
Billy's Dodge Counter DMG increases by 25%.
Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks are treated as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during the skill and able to trigger Perfect Dodges.
When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Dodge, it will automatically become a Dodge Counter.
03
Teachings of the Starlight Knights
Never neglect your training, and never stop improving! This is the philosophy of the Starlight Knights. Billy believes in it wholeheartedly, and practices it sincerely.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Starlight Ballistics
These explosive bullets of Billy's own invention are incredibly lethal at close range.
Their performance far outstrips Billy's original intention of simply making them cooler.
When Billy hits an enemy with his EX Special Attack, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.
05
Lost Technological Constructs
Unknown precision components and unique structural design have given Billy performance far beyond his peers... And maintenance costs far beyond his means.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Starlight Hero
"Hooboy~ Feelin' great! Move aside, Anby, it's my time to shine!"
"Yo, Anby — can you play the Starlight Knight theme?"
—excerpt from Cunning Hares' "Top 10 Forbidden Sentences," selected by Anby
When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Dodge, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.

Core Passive: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat , up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat , she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat .
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend , EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method , EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot , Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame , or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno , she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to X% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup . This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

Version 2.5 
Burnice was made available through the Collectible Exchange .

Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend (AP)

Awakened Potential: Boiling Point Party (AP) 
Version 1.6 
Fixes an issue where Agents Jane, Lucy, Lighter, Burnice, and Tsukishiro Yanagi would consume Assist Points abnormally when using Defensive Assist to parry certain enemies' skills (such as Autonomous Assault Unit - Typhon Destroyer and Dead End Butcher).
Optimizes the invitation events for Agents Ellen , Zhu Yuan , Qingyi , and Burnice . The Invitation Events for these Agents have been upgraded to Quality Time Invites.
Version 1.4 
Optimizes the model precision for Burnice White when the "High-Precision Character Animation" option is enabled.
Version 1.2 
Burnice White was made playable in the first part of version 1.2 with Chapter 4: Tour de Inferno and released in the second part of the same version.
Version 1.1 
Burnice White was introduced as an NPC in the Daily Life of a PubSec Officer Event .
12th August 2024 
Burnice White was announced as an upcoming playable Agent.
Version 1.0 
Burnice White was mentioned in Open-World Dialogue by Luciana de Montefio and was shown in the Zenless Zone Zero Official Release Teaser | The Person You Are Calling Is in a Hollow .

Toggle Text 
01
Spearhead Advance
"Big Daddy taught me that this is when you form a spearheaded formation with overwhelming force and strike at the enemy's weakest point—"
"And I'll be leading the charge, of course!"
When Caesar enters combat or switches in, she instantly buffs the entire team with a Radiant Aegis shield, which can be can be triggered once every 300s. While Radiant Aegis is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% Attribute DMG RES reduction.
02
Legacy of the Far Lands
Caesar's combat style stands out from those of New Eridu or the Outer Ring, drawing from the techniques of the most skilled warriors among the wanderers.
Knowing when to hold back and when to strike decisively—that has always been the wanderer's way of survival. And Caesar has always been a good student of this philosophy.
While Radiant Aegis is active during Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience , Caesar's Energy Generation increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's attack boost is increased to 150% of its original value.
03
Absolute Trust
Once Caesar recognizes someone as one of her own, she fully accepts them as part of her inner circle. She gives them absolute trust, letting her guard down completely...
Just like she does with you now.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Aries the Battering-Ram
One of the tactics Caesar mastered under the guidance of the wanderers.
"No matter what, I'll fight till the last moment!"
When Caesar uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate , she gains 3 additional Assist Points .
If her Energy is below 20, she can activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash with 1 Assist Point instead.
This substitution can only be triggered once every 5s.
05
Romantic Conquest
Behind Caesar's carefree and unpolished apperance lies a romantic at heart.
She's always curious about love stories.
But if you dig a little deeper into the subject... you might just catch her blushing.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Overlord's Will
"I used to keep my eyes straight ahead, thinking that as long as I was strong enough, I could do anything."
"But being a great leader takes more than just power."
"I need to protect my friends behind me — they are the reason I can keep going."
EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash and Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit.

When Caesar uses EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash or Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade , her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.

Profile [ ] 
Since a lot of Celestia School's students are aristocratic, which would make field trips too risky for their safety, and to cut down on the possible competition and show-offs among them, the school does not organize field trips altogether. [ 2 ] The school has a sorority led by Jacqueline . [ 3 ] 
The school's crest is composed of a crescent moon with one wing on each side and a four-pointed star in the center.

Toggle Text 
01
Traveler and Prey
Scents, footsteps, the way someone's eyes shift... those are the "clues" that let me sort hunters from prey. I vanish before I'm hunted. I lower my head before I hunt. That's how I stay alive.
"Home"? That's just something out of a storybook. The endless wild is my hunting cabin.
The Venom gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6.
The DEF ignore from the Core Passive increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES .
Corrode Bone DMG ignores 10% of the target's Electric RES .
02
Hunger and Hard Truths
If I can eat my fill there, it's a good place. If someone gives me food, they're a good person. That's the easiest and most dependable rule in the world. And also, omelet with rice is divine. Even that last leftover bit on the spoon.
After a Chain Attack: Gang Operation or Ultimate: Ophidiophobia hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 Venom .
Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss deals 35% increased DMG.
03
Chains and a Warm Nest
Justice? Order? That kind of righteous, aboveboard stuff makes me shaky. What I know are the rules of the shadows — betrayal, lies, bowing low if it keeps me breathing. I don't mind being used as a tool, as long as the pay is a full meal and a warm corner to curl up in.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
A Rogue's Resolve
The collar around my neck is cold. The handcuffs are heavy. They remind me of the sins I can't wash away. But compared to those invisible rules and icy stares, this kind of restraint with a clear price tag actually puts me at ease... at least I know what it costs. And once I'm back in that little den with a couch and snacks, even the cold metal seems warm.
When using an EX Special Attack , Chain Attack , or Ultimate , gain 1 stack of Decidedness , stacking up to 3 times.
When using Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss , consume all Decidedness . Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom . This Corrode Bone does not cause Daze.
05
False Evidence and Fangs
Memories scorched by blinding light, crimes spelled out in black and white... those "marks" were once all that defined me. But things are different now. I've learned to read, and I've learned to recognize the smell of a lie. When that familiar scent of a scheme creeps in again, I won't just walk into the cage like an idiot. This time, I'll be the one leaving "marks" — with my teeth, and I won't hold back.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Home and Sixth Street
Once there's something I want to hold onto more than just "staying alive," I really do turn stupid. If fate ever decides I have to die, that big, soft couch of yours better not have anyone else lying on it.
"Don't you dare forget me... or I'll bite you to death."
Each time Corrode Bone is triggered, gain 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion .
When attacks from any squad member, other than Corrode Bone , hit an enemy, consume 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion to trigger 1 special Corrode Bone . This instance of Corrode Bone cannot inflict Daze, and at most 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion can be consumed every 3s.

Core Passive: Banquet of Pale Blood 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is considered Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash, which can stack up to 3 times. When Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, 1 stack of Gash is consumed to trigger Maim and deal AoE DMG.
When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead uses the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Claret's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
When Claret enters the battlefield, she gains 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription Crimson Inscription Transforms her weapon into a Blood Axe, replacing Claret's attacks with Bloodbloom Oath skills and increasing her CRIT Rate and Gash Buildup Rate. state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. When Claret uses a Chain Attack, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by X% and Gash Buildup Rate increases by X% . Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.

Mindscape Cinema [ ] 
Each Mindscape awakening requires Agent Focus: Corin ×1 .
Toggle Text 
01
Open Trauma
"The young mistress always said, if something's worth doing, it's worth focusing on."
"I've been practicing, and I can do it now!"
"But... are you watching me...?"
When Corin's Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, her DMG against the target increases by 12% for 15s.
02
Atomic Smash
"Sorry, Mr. or Ms. Ethereal!"
"But I've got work to do... I really am sorry!"
Feeling guilty, Corin sincerely apologizes to the monster — as she wields her savage chainsaw, slicing through the enemies in her way.
When Corin's EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the target's Physical RES is reduced by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
03
Amateur Maid
"I—I'll do my best to become a good maid!" Corin said, walking towards the Ethereals, chainsaw in hand.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Battlefield Retainer
A diligent and serious young maid, Corin always puts her heart and soul into everything she does.
Of course, that includes taking out enemies in combat.
When Corin uses a Quick Assist, Defensive Assist, or Chain Attack, she recovers 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
05
Special Ops Maid
"Uh... sorry, I'm so clumsy. I don't know how to make sure my cuts are even..."
—Said Corin as she looked down at the bits of Ethereal scattered across the ground.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Accumulated Release
Corin knows that she isn't the most powerful of maids, nor the smartest. But she hopes to become the hardest working.
She puts to good use everything she's ever learned.
When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.

Overview [ ] 
The Council represents various influential factions throughout Roscaelifer, each of whom has different values and goals which may be inhibited by the work of the other factions. At the public assemblies held at the CCD Square, they debate one another on their respective issues. All such discussions are headed by Melisande , a member of the AAD who serves as the Speaker.
Currently, all known factions are represented in the council with the exception of the En-Nah Gang , which lacks the influence to be able to compete with the Bangboo Affairs Delegation for seats on the council.

Trivia [ ] 
The icon of the faction is a reference to the Kabbalistic concept of the Tree of Life .
Etymology [ ] 
Dayat is derived from the Hebrew word da'at ( Hebrew : דַּעַת Daʿaṯ ), meaning "knowledge", which is the eleventh sefirot in Kabbalah tradition that appears in some diagrams of the Tree of Life, where the other ten sephirot unite as one and achieve true spiritual balance.

Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across New Eridu Public Security divisions are considered to belong in one Faction. For example, Jane Doe 's Additional Ability: Sore Spot can activate with Cissia , despite them being from different Factions. Likewise, Officer Cui 's Additional Ability: Provisional Security Canine had its text updated in Version 2.7 to say New Eridu Public Security instead of Criminal Investigation Special Response Team .
Overview [ ] 
The Criminal Investigation Special Response Team is a division of PubSec operating out of the Janus Quarter, namely, in the Lumina Square Public Security Office . They are tasked with the investigation of criminal activity, performing raids and in- Hollow operations. Officer Zhu Yuan is the current captain of the team, an exceptional member of the force with no unresolved cases. [ 1 ] The Criminal Investigation team is shown to hire external assistance, most notably Jane Doe , an enigmatic criminal behaviour specialist who serves as both a consultant and an undercover agent for them. Overview [ ] 
Silver Squad was formerly a squad under the Defense Force 's Obsidian Division that consisted of replica soldiers, but it was wiped out during a mission, leaving squad leader Soldier 0 - Anby and Soldier 11 - Harin the only known survivors. Twiggy also managed to survive, but ended up losing all of her limbs and disappeared as black market merchandise for years before managing to obtain the replica manufacturing technology needed in order to revive Silver Squad. She was later stopped by her former captain, now known as Anby Demara , who did not wish to see Silver Company return, and her replicas were destroyed in the process.
Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across New Eridu Defense Force squads are considered to belong in one faction. For example, Soldier 11 's Additional Ability: Fields of Fire can activate with Soldier 0 - Anby , despite them being from different NEDF squads.

Core Passive: Five-Star Service Hotline 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 Positive Reviews . If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by X for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using EX Special Attack: Rock , the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Scissors for 8s.
After using EX Special Attack: Scissors , the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Paper! for 8s.
When EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy, it applies the Malicious Complaint effect. While under Malicious Complaint , if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by Y% . Before recovering from Stun, Malicious Complaint can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Malicious Complaint recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 Positive Reviews per second. When a heavy attack of EX Special Attack: Rock , EX Special Attack: Scissors , or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits enemies, she gains 7.5 Positive Reviews . Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews , when Dialyn triggers the Chain Attack window using Chain Attack: Welcome Mat , EX Special Attack: Get Lost! , or Quick Assist: Forward Call , the next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate . When an ally launches an Ultimate this way, Dialyn consumes 60 Positive Reviews .
With at least 90 Positive Reviews , when Dialyn hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Get Lost! and doesn't trigger a Chain Attack window, she consumes 90 Positive Reviews to forcibly trigger a Chain Attack window. The next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate .
Each time Positive Reviews reaches 90 or an Ultimate is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 Customer Complaint . A maximum of 1 Customer Complaint can be held at a time.

Additional Ability: External Line 
Core Skill 
Additional Ability 
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character:
Dialyn's EX Special Attack CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an EX Special Attack or Ultimate is activated, all squad members gain the Overwhelmingly Positive effect. While Overwhelmingly Positive is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate while Overwhelmingly Positive is active, if the remaining duration of Overwhelmingly Positive is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from EX Special Attack: Rock , EX Special Attack: Scissors , or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an Attack Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock , EX Special Attack: Scissors , and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that Attack Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a Rupture Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock , EX Special Attack: Scissors , and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.

TOPS is the biggest corporate alliance in New Eridu, and our work keeps this city alive~!

Endless noise and constant chatter? No problem — that's what I know best.

Call From the Hollow
The Hollows are a vast tomb, where every echo of life falls silent within its pitch-black coffin.
But to me, it's a call I can never refuse, the final page of every diary, a memo of obsession and lingering resentment.
Even if... all that talk of letting go or holding on, they've got nothing to do with my own story.
"It's alright! I've talked with plenty of clients far harder to communicate with than you~!"

Which day did it end, though? The first time I heard the whispers of the dead? When I was sent into the Hollow as a sacrifice? Or that first night I cried myself to sleep?
With no one to protect me, I had to find my own footing. Unable to forget the past, I pretended to let it go.

Drowned Ideals are phenomena that manifest in areas with high Miasma concentration, particularly in the "town" within Timesworn Hills .

Description [ ] 
"Drowned Ideal" is a term coined by Moss , characterized by entities that maintain the same appearance as the corrupted ones but possess different identities - they are "how people dream themselves to be."
When observed through the Perception Technique , it becomes evident that Drowned Ideals aren't human, but rather share the same ethereal manifestation as other Miasma-derived beings.
In essence, they are Miasmic products formed when the empty Miasmic environment of the Lemnian Hollow corrupts people, guiding and transforming their consciousness and memories.
The Miasma traps the person's true form and materializes their dreams from their memories, replacing their original self with this simulation living within the Hollow.
Tutorial, Ridu Encyclopedia: Tutorial/Drowned Ideal 
Overview [ ] 
Drowned Ideals are Miasmic entities that typically possess the appearance, personality, and memories of real people corrupted by the Miasma. When observed with the Perception Technique, they have the same Ether frequency as other Miasmic objects, such as Miasma Tumors. These entities are the people's "dream selves," embodying their past aspirations and dreams that were given up on. For people who have no dreams of their future selves, their Drowned Ideals may take the shape of other people, or even non-entities such as objects and buildings.
Drowned Ideals act independently from their creators and cannot be controlled. They are able to interact with the physical world. They cannot be injured or killed like living entities, and if destroyed through brute force, they will re-form after time. Drowned Ideals only disappear completely when their creators are killed, or purified from Miasma with devices such as Lumin-Boxes.
History [ ] 
The first known Drowned Ideal was created eight years ago when Ah-Deh , a member of the Defense Force 's special unit, suffered corruption in an empty town in Timesworn Hills. As he was being corrupted into an Ethereal , his desire to spend more time with his daughter created the Drowned Ideal Little Lucia , also known as "Lantern Bearer." Ah-Deh became the Ethereal known as the Wandering Hunter soon after and formed a unique bond with Little Lucia, the latter regarding their interactions together as a game of hide-and-seek. [ 1 ] 
Two weeks prior to the events of Season 2 Chapter 4 , Yidhari Murphy was brought to the town by Sarah , and Yidhari used her ability to recreate past illusions of the town; while doing so, she was sedated by Sarah and the Miasma's influence made her subconsciously attach her desire to "watch others' stories" to the town. Thus, the town itself became Yidhari's Drowned Ideal. Two days later, a group of trapped miners arrived to the town and became Drowned Ideals, while their physical bodies were enveloped in Miasmic cocoons. The next day, an Exaltist named Viggo Moss came to the town to meet with Sarah and help her sedate Yidhari. Moss eventually formed his own Drowned Ideal, regarding it to be his real self and calling his physical body a "shell." As more people arrived, Moss took note of their Drowned Ideals and conducted experiments. He cut into one of the cocoons, and while the person inside quickly became an Ethereal, their Drowned Ideal still existed. However, when Moss killed the Ethereal to prevent it from attacking the other cocoons, that Drowned Ideal vanished forever. Moss kept this a secret from the other Drowned Ideals and only told them that they must protect the cocoons. [ 1 ] 
When Komano Manato , Phaethon , Banyue , and the real Lucia began investigating the town, Manato's Drowned Ideal appeared. Though the Drowned Ideal considered Manato weak due to his reliance on others, after Manato bested him in a fight, the Drowned Ideal seemingly had a change of heart and later helped Manato operate the "Master Lumin" device. After they activated the purification device and the townsfolk were freed from their cocoons, all the Drowned Ideals vanished. Little Lucia also disappeared after the group defeated the Wandering Hunter. [ 2 ]

Toggle Text 
01
Glacial Omen
Chilling winds are an omen of winter, and a signal that Ellen is about to apply for extended leave to hibernate.
Speaking of which, do sharks actually need to hibernate?
Upon hitting an enemy with Swift Scissors during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3.
Upon hitting an enemy with Charged Scissor Strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charge are increased to 6.
For each point of Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen’s CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
02
Arctic Ocean Predator
Despite being freshly stained with red, the massive shears held by Ellen lacked any trace of warmth.
The icy cold stems from her iron-forged instrument, as well as the fear of facing a predator such as herself.
The 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with EX Special Attack: Sharknami.
When using an EX Special Attack, each Flash Freeze Charge increases the current attack's CRIT DMG by 20%, up to a maximum of 60%.
03
Overtime-Intolerant
The whole point of "efficiency" is being able to go home early and sleep.
So strike harder and strike faster.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Endless Hoarfrost
A relentless assault of piercing cold. Terrifying monstrosities will learn the beauty and cruelty of winter under Ellen's blade.
But, actually, the endless work that maids have during holidays is far more cruel...
Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.
05
Adequate Sleep
Except for when in the toughest of battles, Ellen always seems to have that "I can fall asleep at any moment" look.
Many an enemy has met their demise after underestimating Ellen because of it.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv.+2
06
The Feast Begins
An open wound, a drop of blood. A thrilling hunt, a grand feast. A fragile life, a moment of satisfaction.
When Ellen uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or gains Quick Charge, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s.
She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.

Enchainers are powerful entities who serves as The Creator 's emissaries. They are the true rulers of the Great Hollows and are the apex of evolution among beings of the Hollows . [ 1 ] 
Contents
1 Description 
2 Overview 
3 History 
4 Known Enchainers

5 Other Languages

Description [ ] 
An Enchainer is The Creator's most powerful servant and representative, the true ruler of the great Hollows, and the apex of evolution among Ethereals and creations of the Hollows. They possess formidable abilities to alter the rules within a Hollow, demonstrate high-level intelligence, and even have the capacity to move freely outside of Hollows. This overwhelming power, beyond humanity's ability to match, originates from the Creator's authority within them: the Karma Cores.
The Karma Cores are unique Ether cores created by "The Creator," with one corresponding to each of the great Hollows. No matter how powerful an Ethereal evolves to become, without obtaining and fusing with a Karma Core, it can never truly become an Enchainer. At the same time, a Karma Core is also the heart of a Void Hunter weapon . Void Hunters use and control their Void Hunter weapons to suppress the Karma Core, while bearing the cost that comes with doing so.
An ultra-High-Risk Ethereal that stands just one step away from becoming an Enchainer is known as an Enchainer larvae. They cannot leave the Hollows, are capable of simple thought, but for the most part still act on pure instinct. driven by that instinct, they will stop at nothing to seek out and attempt to devour a Karma Core.
To date, we have had no formal contact with any Enchainer. The only known Enchainer was Beliora Vike , the first-generation Void Hunter who fell completely after fusing with a Karma Core, and was hunted down by Remielle Dan a century ago. However, we have had direct confrontations with several Enchainer larvae, namely: Girtablullu , Bashmu , and the Primordial Nightmare .
Tutorial, Ridu Encyclopedia: Enchainers 
Overview [ ] 
Enchainers are incredibly powerful Ethereals, being able to alter the rules of Hollows at will. Unlike Ethereals , the Enchainers are highly intelligent and capable of moving freely outside of Hollows. [ 1 ] 
The Creator made the Enchainers by first creating the Karma Cores, which are the origin of their rule-altering powers. The Void Hunter Weapons were created from a Karma Core sealed in Porcelloy , and as such, can transform their users in to Enchainers. As the Void Hunter weapons and the Creator share the same origin, the side effects of the weapons are able to be lifted by the Creator's power, and the weapons can kill the Creator. [ 2 ] While an Enchainer can be killed, their Karma Core seemingly cannot be destroyed, and will endure after its Enchainer's death.
Beings that are on the cusp of becoming an Enchainer are known as Enchainer larvae, and include ultra-High-Risk Ethereals such as Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator" , Girtablullu and Bashmu , but it is impossible to become an Enchainer without absorbing a Karma Core. They are thus still limited as Ethereals are, being unable to leave Hollows and being driven by instinct beyond some capacity for simple thought. Enchainer larvae are naturally driven to find and consume Karma Cores to further their evolution, even if they are sealed within Void Hunter Weapons.
Beliora Vike is the first and currently only known individual who was transformed in to an Enchainer while originally being human. Remielle Dan is in a state of being "half-Enchainer" due to partially fusing with the Karma Core inside Thaumiel , and is at risk of fully transforming into an Enchainer due to continued usage of it. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] The Enchainer Larva Bashmu, having absorbed a fragment of the Karma Core once held by Sunbringer , is progressing towards becoming a fully fledged Enchainer.
History [ ] 
The Karma Cores were first created by The Creator, and became the basis for their Enchainers, with one core corresponding to each of the Great Hollows. One of the Enchainers - Sunbringer, would defeat and help the newly assembled Void Hunters to slay another, with its Karma Core was then taken into custody. After being subsumed in Porcelloy, this core became the basis for the Void Hunter Weapons, and Helios Academy, in a project helmed by Sunbringer and Arche called "Project Sunseeker", attempted to create Artificial Enchainers who could use the powers of an Enchainer to fight back against The Creator. [ 5 ] 
This ultimately ended in tragedy, as Colonel Vike was corrupted and fully transformed into an Enchainer, losing her humanity and destroying anything in her path before she was slain by Remielle, going on to be known as the Day of Silence. [ 6 ] Experiments with the Karma Cores continued however, and at some point, Sunbringer took the Karma Core she bore and fragmented it into three parts, from which she used her power of Genesis Reconstruction to create a vessel for them - Eldreda , Lindverne and Dracaene . [ 7 ] Due to being Ethereals created from Karma Cores, this also makes the three Sunbringers Enchainers, though it is unknown if they have access to the original's Genesis Reconstruction powers.
After Sarah became the Primordial Nightmare, she sought to absorb the Qingming Sword 's power to become an Enchainer, which would have resulted in her becoming the lord of the Lemnian Hollow , but it was slain through the efforts of Ye Shunguang , Zhao and Phaethon before it could achieve this. [ 8 ] 
When Girtablullu forcibly fused with Dracaene Sunbringer 's portion of the Karma Core, it evolved into a stronger form , but was killed by Remielle Dan and Phaethon . However, the Karma Core was not recovered as Bashmu ate Girtablullu's corpse and fled, leaving her in a comatose state. [ 4 ]

The En-Nah Gang is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . They are a group of Bangboo who cause trouble throughout Roscaelifer .
Contents
1 Overview 
2 History 
3 Members 
3.1 Non-Playable Members 
4 Other Languages 
5 Change History 
6 References 
7 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
The En-Nah Gang are noted for being made up primarily of passionate but mischievous Bangboo, who stir up trouble across Booastrum , but somehow have avoided the ire of the Airspace Patrol and AAD . They have strong beliefs about Roscaelifer opening up to the rest of New Eridu , being staunchly against it, and believing that Roscaelifer is a city made only for Bangboo by "Sunbringer" , and so humans from the surface should be kept out. As such, currently only Bangboo are known to make up the membership of the gang, and their primary base is in the Retroflux Zone - an area humans can't easily access.
Many of the Bangboo that make up the gang are specifically Databoo who, through their processing of the Rosetta Data , have a "revelation", in which they see true Sunbringer, imprisoned in endless darkness. Their beliefs about Sunbringer are based on this idea, and as such they consider Eldreda , Lindverne and Dracaene to be imposters, and have no respect for them. The gang is known to have a specific kind of slang, most prominently they end their sentences with "gah".
Currently the En-Nah Gang lacks numbers and influence, being unable to challenge the Bangboo Affairs Delegation for seats on the Council of Representatives , and their leader Griff expresses frustration that the Airspace Patrol doesn't take them seriously. Griff often comes to blows often with his brother Reginald , who heads the Bangboo Affairs Department. [ 1 ] 
The En-Nah Gang has a "long-cherished wish" they wish to fulfill, and they apparently also possess evidence that, if revealed, would overturn the entire structure of the city. [ 2 ] 
History [ ] 
The En-Nah Gang was originally founded by Prophetboo - the first Bangboo to ever have the revelation about Lady Sunbringer. Given Prophetboo himself originates from the era when Roscaelifer was founded, the exact time that the gang was first established is unknown. The gang has been slowly accruing members over time, hoping to build up its influence enough to be taken seriously. At some point in time leadership of the gang fell to Griff Ashton . When Remielle Dan returned to Roscaelifer, Prophetboo immediately recognised her, and directed the gang to support and shelter her, with the gang setting aside a place for her to stay, and finding old arcade cabinets for her to play in her downtime at her request.
When delegates from HAND , the HIA , White Star Institute and TOPS arrived in Roscaelifer, members of the gang attempted to disrupt the introductory tea party help for them, but given the nature of the prank it ultimately ended in applause. [ 3 ] As Phaethon began investigating the ongoing case of Bangboo murders, a clue from the footage acquired led them to investigate the En-Nah Gang, using Eous to infiltrate their base. Though eventually they were found out, Prophetboo delegated judgement of them to Remielle, who vouched for them, extending the gang's support to Phaethon. [ 4 ] 
The En-Nah Gang provided support to the pair throughout their investigation, but were later unable to prevent Sigrid from finding them after the Girtablullu possessed Dracaene attacked Phaethon. [ 5 ] Despite this, Sigrid would become a collaborator in their plans, and the Gang continued to support the group as they worked to kill Girtablullu and save Dracaene. They have continued to shelter Remielle following this.

Etheric Other
Pyrois, Phaethon's Etheric Other 
Type
Lore 
Etheric Others are mysterious Etheric entities, born from the Ether within an individual.
Contents
1 Overview 
2 History 
3 Known Etheric Others 
4 Other Languages 
5 Change History 
6 References 
7 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
An Etheric Other is a physical manifestation of highly concentrated Ether energy that exists within an individual. [ 1 ] Such a being requires its host body to have an immense amount of Ether residing within it, and then a stable medium to manifest through such as Porcelloy .
Etheric Others are not independent entities, instead being a representation of the power generated from the body and soul of a person, referred to as an " Etheric Other User ". Currently, Pyrois , born from the power of Helios within Phaethon , and the unnamed Etheric Other born of the power within Truvia , are the only known examples of these entities. In the former case, Helios and Phaethon are both able to assume direct control of Pyrois, where Truvia can do the same, though it is unknown what will, if any, controls hers when she is not piloting it.
It is possible to disrupt the Ether flow of an Etheric Other, causing its physical form to dissipate. This has thus far been down with a special firearm created by the CCD , and though its effects were not immediate, they also disrupted the host's ability to manipulate Ether briefly. When an Etheric Other is disrupted in this manner, if their host is inhabiting them, the Etheric Other will crumble to pieces, revealing the host within.
Due to the rarity of Etheric Others, information about them and their history is highly limited.
History [ ] 
The origin of Etheric Others is unknown, but they were known to exist in some capacity before Phaethon materialized Pyrois for the first time. [ 2 ] 
After coming in to contact with The Creator , the Ether within Phaethon began to spiral out of control, culminating in Helios , the entity within Phaethon, to take control of their body and mutate in to a monstrous form , which only served as the catalyst for Helios to fully manifest. After it was suppressed by Remielle Dan , Phaethon went to Roscaelifer to undergo treatment for this overflow of Ether within them. [ 3 ] 
Upon arriving at the CCD for treatment, Phaethon and Helios had an internal confrontation, with Phaethon winning and Helios begrudgingly loaning them a portion of its power. Having absorbed a large amount of Porcelloy in to themselves as part of the treatment, this allowed Phaethon to materialize their Etheric Other: Pyrois, for the first time. [ 4 ] Pyrois would then go on to aid Phaethon in their endeavours throughout Roscaelifer.
At an unknown point in time, Truvia became able to manifest an Etheric Other, and when she and Phaethon came to blows, said Etheric Other fought directly against Pyrois and Phoenix .

Dreamweave
The distant, blurred light seemed to be a dream she had crafted, an unreachable future. It wasn't about atonement, but a yearning for freedom.

"To me, that light was unfamiliar, something I should have steered clear of, but it broke through every barrier, as though it was trying to remind me that beyond the darkness, there was something worth chasing."
When Evelyn recalls the first time she met Astra Yao, there's a rare softness in her tone.
Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%.

Metamorphosis
At that moment, she frees herself from her restraints and becomes her truest self. The tightened ropes snap, and the chains turn into a broken cocoon. Evelyn stands at the boundary of rebirth, and in her cold, sharp gaze, there is the flicker of a faint, soft glow.

"You know, Eve? Every time I meet someone important to me, my heart goes 'thump-thump!'"
Evelyn sighs, signaling that it was getting late. Astra quickly fastens the back of her gown and rushed out the door.
"Thump thump," Evelyn mutters to herself, left alone in the dressing room.
Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate , Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
Her threads, dyed crimson like the clouds at dawn.
After each attack, she spins elegantly, blazing flames scattering like the morning light. No words are needed — Evelyn's protection has turned into a radiant flame.

Where there is light, there will always be shadow.
It silently hides, tracing the light's path, guarding each bright burst. The shadow never tries to steal the light's brilliance, but at every turn, it quietly fills those corners the light cannot reach. The two have never been separated, nor can they be — light is whole because of shadow, and shadow exists because of light. It's an eternal pursuit, an unspeakable connection.

The External Strategy Department (E.S.D.) , full name Roscaelifer External Strategy Department , is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . It is one of the Five Central Departments of Roscaelifer .

Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across Roscaelifer departments are considered to belong in one faction. This is known because Ultra Jake 's Additional Ability description states that the ability activates if there are Roscaelifer Agents in the squad, but it is not restricted to specifically External Strategy Department Agents, for example.
Overview [ ] 
The External Strategy Department serves as Roscaelifer's bridge to the outside world, coordinating relations between it and the other districts of New Eridu . The ESD maintains close ties with the Marcel Group , and its personnel often operate under Marcel Group cover identities when carrying out official duties outside of Roscaelifer. [ 1 ] 
The ESD is responsible for erasing the memories of all Bangboo who leave Roscaelifer, which is an experience considered akin to death for ithem. As such, most Bangboo treat the ESD with resentment and disdain, especially the Administrative Director Velina Airgid , whom many call the "Death Witch." [ 2 ] However, following the events of A Sleepwalker's Confession , this misunderstanding has been resolved.

Overview [ ] 
The Flint family are the founders and owners of Flint Workshop , one of the Five Central Departments of Roscaelifer. They are the world's sole producer of Flint Porcelloy . This is due to the fact that Porcelume —the main component of Porcelloy—has difficulties bonding with other metals, and requires Flint blood in order to catalyze a stable bond. Thus, only the Flint family has the facilities to forge Porcelloy, and it is considered a highly precious material. [ 1 ] 
There are many rumors and mysterious legends surrounding the family, especially pertaining to vampires. [ 2 ] The ballad Thorned Rose was written about these legends. [ 3 ] 
Claret Flint is the current head of the family. Due to her position, she holds a large amount of influence across Roscaelifer, though she never uses it for personal gain. [ 4 ] 
History [ ] 
Long ago, the Flint family ancestors chose to settle in Roscaelifer. They made a pact with "Sunbringer" that in exchange for her protection and help with research, [ 1 ] they would provide Porcelloy equipment and technology for the city. The family has honored this pact for generations, continuing to supply Roscaelifer with Porcelloy to this day. [ 5 ]

Flint Porcelloy , often shortened to just Porcelloy , is a composite formed from Porcelume and certain metals. [ 1 ] 
Contents
1 Properties 
2 Trivia 
2.1 Etymology 
3 Other Languages 
4 Change History 
5 References 
6 Navigation 
Properties [ ] 
Porcelloy has an unusually strong stabilizing effect on Ether . Due to its high value, it is a material kept under strict regulation. [ 1 ] While Porcelloy itself is relatively simple to make, it is unique in the sense that it requires the blood of a member of the Flint Family as a catalyst in order to activate its effects, which is why Flint Workshop is the only producer of it in New Eridu. [ 2 ] 
Trivia [ ] 
Etymology [ ] 
辉金 huījīn means "bright/radiant gold."
Porcelloy is a portmanteau of the words "porcelain" and "alloy," reflecting its nature of being a Porcelume-composite alloy.

The Flint Workshop , full name Roscaelifer Flint Workshop , is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . It is one of the Five Central Departments of Roscaelifer .
Contents

Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across Roscaelifer departments are considered to belong in one faction. This is known because Ultra Jake 's Additional Ability description states that the ability activates if there are Roscaelifer Agents in the squad, but it is not restricted to specifically External Strategy Department Agents, for example.
Overview [ ] 
Flint Workshop is based on the islet of Vyrium and operates with a high degree of autonomy. It is the sole producer and manufacturer of Flint Porcelloy , possessing the world's only Porcelloy forging technology, and it is responsible for the R&D of Porcelloy products and technology. it has honored an ancient pact for generations, providing Roscaelifer with equipment research and development, as well as hardware support. [ 1 ] Some of the original Void Hunter Weapons were crafted by this workshop. [ 2 ]

Official Description [ ] 
Frostveil 
Xiao'Zhao's weapon, "Frostveil," is an experimental asset supplied through a confidential TOPS research project. Rather than merely projecting Ice-aligned Ether into strikes, the weapon channels Ether into its own structure. Under normal conditions, Frostveil is only half the weight of comparable weapons, but once in combat, its rapidly condensed ice edge gains far greater destructive power. The design might as well have been tailor-made for Xiao'Zhao. [ 1 ]
