Toggle Text 
01
Recharge Chamber
Efficiency is the lifeblood of engineering, and within Grace's gun barrel resonates its heartbeat.
When the 4th hit of Grace's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy.
Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.
02
Lightning Piercer
"Dissecting" complex mechanical structures is Grace's greatest hobby, even in the midst of battle.
How does it feel to get taken apart, with every vulnerability laid bare?
When Grace's grenade hits an enemy during a Basic Attack , Special Attack , or EX Special Attack , the target's Electric RES is reduced by 8.5%, and Electric Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.
03
Chief Mechanic
Grace was personally involved in writing the "Belobog Industries' Construction Safety Guidelines."
She's also the employee who violated the "no dangerous explosives at construction sites" policy the most times.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Burst Capacitor
Anton suspected within the component Grace referred to as the "Electropulse Recycling Module," there was, in fact, an Ether hamster tirelessly generating energy around the clock.
"Can you equip me bro with one too?".
When Grace uses her EX Special Attack , she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks).
When her Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike or Dash Attack: Quick Inspection hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the attack by 20%.
05
Frosty Cold Iron Witch
The "Frosty Cold Iron Witch" is capable of taming any mechanical beast, or at least that's what the anonymous fan who came up with the name thinks.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Detonation Trigger
The average blood temperature of Belobog Heavy Industries' employees is ninety-eight degrees Celcius. Grace is often viewed as the safety valve keeping them all from boiling.
When even Grace gives up control, it's a sign for everyone to cover their ears.
When all Zap stacks are consumed to activate a Special Attack or EX Special Attack , Grace's skill is enhanced, tossing an extra grenade and increasing each grenade's DMG to 200%.

In-Game Descriptions [ ] 
Yixuan [ ] 
Since its founding, Yunkui Summit has dedicated itself to helping others and aiding humanity.
Only those who have mastered the Way of Ether to perfection, reaching the pinnacle of their craft, can be called "Grandmasters" of Yunkui Summit.
As time passed, the sect changed, losing its former glory. Yet the 13th High Preceptor Yixuan
still walks the streets of New Eridu, solving troubles and bringing blessings to those in need.
In these peaceful days that pass one after another, people only know Yunkui Summit as a place of fortune-telling and worship, rather than a sanctuary for all.
Until the howling calamity of despair descends, and that silver-haired figure emerges again in the night...
Only then will people truly understand what it means to be a Grandmaster of Yunkui Summit.

title: Hollow Champion
text:
This article is about the event's lore. For the story episode, see Hollow Champion Competition .
Hollow Champion
Type
Lore 
Hollow Champion , also called the Hollow Champion competition, is an annual competition held in New Eridu wherein contestants defeat Ethereals within a set time limit for points. [ 1 ] 
Contents
1 Overview 
2 History 
2.1 Round 1 Results 
3 Other Languages 
4 Change History 
5 References 
6 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
Registering as a contestant for Hollow Champion is extremely simple: the contestant must only provide their name, with no ID verification or other checks required. Contestants may compete solo or join as a team, with no limit on the amount of team members. Each team's members can view their team roster at any time to ensure the competition is fair. Team points are calculated based on both the difficulty level of the hunted Ethereals and the number of team members.
Upon registration, each participant is given a Beginner Ethereal Card , which calculates points based on their combat performance and obtains Carrots from official data terminals in the Hollow . The card is the only proof of participant status, is non-refundable, non-transferable, and its destruction will result in immediate disqualification. A disqualified participant's points will be reset to zero, but the team participant number coefficient will not remove them, which lowers the team's overall score. Anti-cheat measures have been added to the Ethereal cards ever since a programmer hid a cheat code in one card years ago, during one of the early competitions. [ 2 ] 
The competition features four stages, each stage taking place in a different Hollow environment. After all four stages are completed, the contestants are ranked by their points, which can be redeemed for prizes or cash rewards. In order to prevent exhaustion, a five-to-seven-day break is placed after each stage. [ 1 ] The event organizers also install Ether Disruptors throughout the Hollows in order to keep the environment stable, and set up rest areas for the contestants in safe zones. [ 3 ] 
History [ ] 
The competition has existed for decades, since the time of the Old Capital , and was designed to boosts citizens' confidence in tackling Hollows. [ 1 ] The rules are lax and it offers a large amount of prize money, so many reckless participants are drawn in to the competition, including criminals. The event organizers eventually secured approval from the city administration and officially became known as the Hollow Extreme Athletics League (HEAL), and over time, the competition became more regulated. [ 4 ] 
During the events of Season 2 Epilogue, Phaethon teamed up with the Cunning Hares to join the competition, which was sponsored by Rusty Cliff Corp. of the TOPS Alliance. The prize pool included pure gold statues, advanced Hollow equipment, precious antiques, high-purity Porcelume products, Bangboo photo collections, 60%-new replaceable Intelligent Construct joints, and a Flint Porcelloy W-Engine . [ 1 ] However, following various civilian deaths in the first stage, the competition was suspended until further notice. The culprit, Romeul , stole all the prizes and scattered them throughout the Hollow in order to incite chaos amongst all participants. He attempted to escape with the Porcelloy W-Engine, but he was defeated by Phaethon and arrested by Public Security . A spokesperson from HEAL stated that the competition would be reorganized as soon as possible, and background checks would be run on all contestants to ensure everyone's safety. [ 5 ]

01
Frost Atop the Snow
Miyabi has loved reciting poems about the cold since she was a child. She might not understand them completely, but she still does it every day.
Before long, she came to realize their true meaning.
She found clarity not on a still and snowy night, but rather upon the battlefield.
While in Shimotsuki Stance , every 1 point of Fallen Frost consumed will allow Basic Attack: Shimotsuki to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until Shimotsuki Stance ends.
When a charge-level three slash of Basic Attack: Shimotsuki hits an enemy suffering Frostburn , it will immediately remove the Frostburn state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.
02
Breath Technique
"As goes the sword, so goes the heart." This is a key disciplinary concept of the Hoshimi school of swordsmanship.
Defeating the enemy is but the first step on the path to victory.
Maintaining constant vigilance at all times is the true way of a warrior.
Basic Attack: Kazahana and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 30%.
Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of Fallen Frost when the final move of the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Kazahana hits an enemy.
Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of Fallen Frost and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
03
Martial Discipline
Miyabi, whose family has a tradition of martial arts, has excellent training habits. Her commitment to swordsmanship practice is unwavering. What? A meeting? She won't be going.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Rupture
Reciting poems during the heat of battle can regulate one's respiratory rhythm.
Whether it's her mindset or breathing, Miyabi always keeps calm.
Frostburn - Break DMG increases by 30%. Upon triggering Frostburn - Break , Hoshimi Miyabi generates 250 more Decibels.
05
Anniversary
The girl arrives at that all too familiar place with flowers, her breath misting and then vanishing into the cold air.
Her fingers ghost over that name on the monument.
Everything is quiet, like that most silence observer.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Prodigious Talent
The more she battles, the more it becomes evident to outsiders: If there is a god of swordsmanship, it must greatly favor Hoshimi Miyabi.
During Shimotsuki Stance , Hoshimi Miyabi obtains Polar , which increases Basic Attack: Shimotsuki DMG by 30%. After obtaining Polar , Hoshimi Miyabi will automatically draw her blade and unleash powerful slashes based on the current charge level upon consuming Fallen Frost . Before Fallen Frost is completely depleted, the draw and slashes will not interrupt charging under Shimotsuki Stance . Each occurrence of Shimotsuki Stance can perform up to 3 draws and slashes.

Overview [ ] 
The de L'Azur family has a close connection to Lindverne Sunbringer , the head of the Airspace Patrol Department . The family's vow is to follow Lindverne for generations, though Lindverne herself dislikes the word "follow" and instead regards each de L'Azur as a comrade, friend, and mutual mentor-and-student. The bond between House de L'Azur and Lindverne can be seen as both blessing and curse: a curse for Lindverne, who outlives every de L'Azur and inevitably loses them, but a blessing for Sigrid and the other de L'Azurs, who will always have Lindverne for an entire lifetime. [ 1 ] 
As a noble family, House de L'Azur takes the hosting courtesies and food quality of afternoon tea very seriously. [ 2 ] Sigrid is the eldest daughter [ 3 ] and therefore the heir apparent, [ 4 ] though she is not yet expected to handle all social responsibilities for the family as she is still young.
History [ ] 
Each family head has served as Airspace Patrol's Deputy Administrative Director for five generations, going back to Sigrid's great-great-grandmother: [ 5 ] the first known de L'Azur, who was present at the creation of Roscaelifer. [ 6 ] She fought on the frontlines of the Hollows to defend Roscaelifer and became Lindverne's first deputy. [ 7 ] Though there were methods for de L'Azur to gain "eternal immortality" and remain deputy forever, she refused, choosing to pass away of natural causes. [ 8 ]

Core Passive: Terminating Verdict 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
When Chain Attack: Trick of Fate hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the Dark Abyss Reverb state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 Stun characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by X / Y .
When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by X% . Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by X% ; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by Y% . The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of X% .
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

The Inter-Knot (stylized in capitals as the INTER-KNOT ), also known as the Proxy Network , is an organization in the world of Zenless Zone Zero and also an in-game Menu screen where players can check their Inter-Knot notifications, schedule, and Proxy Primer.
The Inter-Knot menu can be accessed from the Main Menu or by pressing J while in the city.
Contents
1 Overview 
2 Notifications 
3 Intel Board 
4 Schedule 
5 Trivia 
5.1 Etymology 
6 Other Languages 
7 Change History 
8 References 
9 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
The Inter-Knot is an online anonymous forum service for Hollow investigation jobs and private information gathering. [ 1 ] Though it has a similar name, the Inter-Knot is not the game's version of the real-life internet, as the internet exists as a separate entity; it is more likely to be the equivalent of the dark web . Jobs posted on the Inter-Knot are typically jobs that are not accepted by the Hollow Investigative Association due to risks or legal complications, or personal matters that require discretion. Despite the illegal nature of the Inter-Knot, even affiliates of official organizations such as NEDF 's Obsidian Division or the HIA may post job offerings. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] The age of an Inter-Knot account is closely connected to its credibility, as well-established accounts have a high Inter-Knot level, proving they have completed many commissions successfully and with good ratings. [ 4 ] 
During the events of the main story , the player loses their main Inter-Knot account and must rebuild their reputation on a new account. [ 1 ] 
Notifications [ ] 
Main article: Inter-Knot/Posts 
The Notifications section is presented like a message board, where the player can read various posts and reply to some. Some of the posts allow the player to reply to clients and take on Commissions .
Intel Board [ ] 
Main article: Inter-Knot/Intel Board 
Once a player has joined an Outpost , they can use the Intel Board to post their own commissions. Commissions can be posted for certain H.D.D Commissions, Expert Challenge stages, and Notorious Hunt stages. Other members of the Outpost will then be able to accept and complete those commissions. Once completed, the requester will receive the rewards from whichever commission or stage they requested assistance on, while the person who completed it for them will receive Outpost Trust and Contribution Points .
Outpost Trust will be used to increase the player's Permission Level , while Contribution Points can be used in the Points Exchange store, to purchase various items.
Schedule [ ] 
Main article: Commission 
The Schedule shows details and progress of current Commissions and allows the player to track any Commissions they'd like to take on at the moment.
Trivia [ ] 
Etymology [ ] 
"Inter-Knot" is a play on the words "internet" and "knot," the latter referencing the Chinese name of Proxies ( 绳匠 Shéngjiàng , "rope artisan" ).

Passion 
Basic Attack 
When Jane triggers Perfect Dodge , Defensive Assist , or performs a move that deals damage to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream . Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream , Jane enters the Passion state.
While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120 points, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage expend Passion Stream . Activating a Perfect Dodge or Defensive Assist regenerates Passion Stream . Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is expended.
This skill does not feature any scaling.

Basic Attack: Salchow Jump 
Basic Attack 
Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump .
When available, hold to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a finishing strike, dealing Physical DMG .
Hold the button during the continuous attacks to extend the skill duration. Release to trigger the finishing strike early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the continuous attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the finishing strike.
Using Basic Attack: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream .

[ Edit History ]
Version 2.5 
Jane was made available through the Collectible Exchange .
Version 2.1 
Fixes missing English voice lines for Agent Jane in previous versions.
Some of Jane's Quality Time dialogue was updated .
Version 1.7 
Optimizes the invitation events for Agents Lighter and Jane. The Invitation Events for these Agents have been upgraded to Quality Time Invites.
Optimizes the text description for Agent Jane's Mindscape Cinema 06 "Shady" Technique. This adjustment is purely textual and does not affect the actual functionality of the agent's skills.
Before adjustment : When Assault triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
After adjustment : When that instance of Assault triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
Version 1.6 
Fixes an issue where Agents Jane, Lucy, Lighter, Burnice, and Tsukishiro Yanagi would consume Assist Points abnormally when using Defensive Assist to parry certain enemies' skills (such as Autonomous Assault Unit - Typhon Destroyer and Dead End Butcher).
Version 1.1 
Jane Doe was made playable in the first part of version 1.1 with the Special Episode "Undercover R&B" and released in the second part of the same version.
12th July 2024 
Jane Doe was announced as an upcoming playable Agent.
Version 1.0 
Jane Doe was shown in the Zenless Zone Zero Official Release Teaser | The Person You Are Calling Is in a Hollow .

Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game 
Dodge 
Dash Attack 
After using Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge , hold to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the stick/joystick to move and deal Physical DMG upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Fire DMG and granting 25 points of Might . The maximum for Momentum is 15.
When dealing Fire DMG , if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron .
Releasing will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to attack enemies. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

Karma Cores are objects made by The Creator . They are the cores of Enchainers , with some sealed within the Void Hunter Weapons . [ 1 ] 
Contents
1 Overview 
2 History 
3 Other Languages 
4 Change History 
5 References 
6 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
Karma Cores are powerful objects reminiscent of Ethereal cores, but are made specifically by The Creator, rather than manifesting as part of the corruption process. The Creator used these cores as the basis for their Enchainers - their emissaries who govern the Great Hollows . The Karma Cores are able to alter the rules within Hollows , and this power is accessible by both the Enchainers and the Void Hunter Weapons that contain them. Karma Cores are not destroyed when the Enchainer they are wielded by dies. [ 1 ] 
It is possible for other beings, particularly powerful Ethereals, to become Enchainers by consuming a Karma Core and ascending to this level of power. Beings who are on the cusp of achieving this are known as Enchainer larvae. [ 1 ] 
Based on currently available information, there are six Karma Cores in existence, four of which are currently known about in detail:
One infused into Tailless .
One infused into the Qingming Sword .
One infused into Thaumiel , that is also partially fused with its user Remielle . It has the power to halt the flow of time. [ 2 ] 
The Karma Core of "Sunbringer" . This Core was split in to three fragments and distributed to Sunbringer's other selves.
The fragment once held by Dracaene has since been claimed by Bashmu , while the other two remain with Eldreda and Lindverne .
History [ ] 
When the Karma Cores, and by extension the Enchainers, first appeared is unknown, but the original Void Hunters managed to defeat an Enchainer in the past, and recovered its core, using it as the basis for the Void Hunter Weapons by way of sealing the core in Porcelloy . Due to this power coming from The Creator though, the weapons exacted a toll from their users over time. Arche and Sunbringer began Project Sunseeker with the aim of infusing the Void Hunters directly with the Karma Cores in their weapons, with the hopes this would grant them even greater power while avoiding the side effects, becoming Artificial Enchainers, but this project ended in disaster when Beliora Vike transformed into an Enchainer and went berserk, before being killed by Remielle. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] 
Following this, Remielle Dan became trapped in temporal stasis due to Thaumiel for a century, and Lady Sunbringer took the Karma Core in her possession and split it in three, bestowing a piece to each of her three other selves. [ 2 ] [ 4 ] 
In the modern day, The Exaltists tried to utilise the power of Tailless for themselves, but were ultimately defeated, and later their final Overseer Sarah , after becoming an Enchainer larva , attempted to claim the Qingming Sword and the core within, but was unsuccessful in turn, though this did awaken The Creator. [ 5 ] Dracaene's core fragment was stripped from her after she partially fused with Girtablullu . After it was killed, Bashmu consumed its remains, absorbing the core fragment and pushing along its own development into an Enchainer. [ 6 ]

Mindscape Cinema [ ] 
Each Mindscape awakening requires Agent Focus: Koleda ×1 .
Toggle Text 
01
Beat of the Hammer
Her fiery temper is just a facade. In reality, Koleda's thoughts are quite intricate. For example, she knows when to swing her hammer for a more painful strike.
After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or her enhanced Basic Attack , quickly use a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.
02
Kinetic Recovery
Koleda believes perfect hammering has its own natural rhythm.
It's like tapping a tambourine, with each hit building up the tempo of the next beat.
Of course, it's hard to say how many taps her "toys" can endure.
When Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
03
"Mind Your Own!"
As a qualified "toy," you better not cause trouble when Koleda starts to get a feel for swinging her hammer. Just take the beating.
— After all, what's the point of resisting?
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Furnace's Glow
Koleda feels the flames of war as her hammer swings raise the surrounding temperature. 
She's now even more flammable and explosive than Ether.
Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Basic Attack .
When her Chain Attack: Natural Disaster or Ultimate: Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.
05
"You Dare Underestimate Me?"
Koleda cares deeply about her role as a young leader potentially causing others to underestimate Belobog Heavy Industries. To compensate, she consistently trains diligently in secret.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Saturated Blast
There are two types of people that Koleda really hates:
Stupid people, and hopelessly stupid people.
Luckily for her, Belobog always has a good supply of strong Ether explosives — plenty to use on the stupid.
When EX Special Attack , Chain Attack , or Ultimate triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.

Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice 
Special Attack 
Press to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart . HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes . If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

The Krampus Compliance Authority , or Krampus for short, is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . It is a subsidiary of TOPS .

Overview [ ] 
Despite being part of The Outstanding Paragons Alliance, Krampus is not a company, but instead a self-regulatory organization for TOPS. Krampus's goal is to watch over the ongoings of the TOPS Round Table, seeing if all actions, no matter how cutthroat or morally grey, follow the core rules and interests of the alliance. If these rules are broken, Krampus is sent to interfere and punish the rule-breakers. [ 1 ] 
Krampus's members are known as 'Judges' each are notably unique, with no uniform-code or shared traits. From a customer service representative for TOPS , an Intelligent Construct that runs a martial-arts school , and a former-Sweeper, turned executioner as a form of redemption .
Krampus has gained a fearful reputation in TOPS, with one its members, Zhao , being seen and often called a "disaster" by employees working for corrupt companies in the alliance. [ 2 ] 
The current Boss of Krampus serves as a member of the TOPS Round Table. Very little is known about her, but she commands the respect of all of its members, who very rarely, if ever, refuse her orders.

Trivia [ ] 
Etymology [ ] 
Krampus is a mythological figure from Alpine folklore. He is seen as the evil counterpart to Saint Nicholas , another legendary figure that inspired Santa Claus . Whilst Saint Nicholas would visit the houses of good children and leave gifts, Krampus would punish the naughty children by usually spanking them with birch branches or, even worse, condemning them to the underworld.
This name fits in with Krampus Compliance Authority's goal of punishing rulebreakers within TOPS.
The faction's primary release during the latter-half of November and all of December may also signify its connection to the Christmas season.
Each member of the Krampus Compliance Authority takes inspiration from various kinds of circus performers and illusionists:
Zhao 's Thiren species is likely a reference to the traditional hat-trick , which usually produces a rabbit from a top hat.
Dialyn is likely inspired by hoop dancers .
Banyue is likely a reference to ringleaders and rolling globe jugglers .
Promeia is based on escape artists , such as the famous Harry Houdini .
Phoenix is likely a reference to fire-manipulating tricks and surviving seemingly-lethal stage tricks.

Core Passive: Accelerant 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale , up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist . Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack . When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale . With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by X% , up to a maximum increase of X% , and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale .

Toggle Text 
01
The Champion
Victory for the champion is crucial. By facing off against the strongest fighter from the opposing side, he eliminates the threat to his leader — bringing an immense morale uplift to the team.
For him, only victory deserves recognition.
"The Champion cannot be defeated."
Among the debuffs imposed by Core Passive: Accelerant , the Collapse effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
02
Red Scarf
As the "Red Scarf" of the Sons of Calydon, Lighter is quite famous in the Outer Ring, and not just because of his fists, but also due to... his unique way of speaking.
"I enjoy taking it easy... but you wouldn't manage without me, would you?"
When applying Collapse via Core Passive: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Ice DMG and Fire DMG provided by Elation from Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.
03
Mercenary Leader
"I'm probably the last person anyone should pick as their leader."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Sunglasses
"You're asking why I wear sunglasses? Uh... it's because I get queasy at the sight of blood, I guess."
When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
05
Decision Maker
"Give me an order, and I'll carry it out. It's that simple."
Lighter adjusted his sunglasses with a carefree smile.
"Just don't put me in charge of making decisions."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Survivor
If given the chance to do it all over again, he would never opt to be the only survivor.
Unfortunately, fate is rarely a choice.
Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Basic Attack , Dodge Counter , Special Attack , EX Special Attack , Quick Assist , Assist Follow-Up , Chain Attack , or Ultimate , it will trigger the Blazing Impact effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Fire DMG . This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impact by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impact when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.

Lighter was released as a playable Agent.

EX Special Attack 
With enough Energy, press to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony . When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG .
When Lucia uses any Harmony , all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional X Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of Y , lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional Z of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring , Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack .
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony .
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Ultimate 
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony . When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG . A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence . Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence , the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to X% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony . If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony , she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

Toggle Text 
01
Secret Friend
As a child, Lucia's grandmother took her by the hand and led her into the Hollows.
From that moment on, she roamed its darkened trails and hunted in its boundless depths. With her brush, she painted the Ethereals she encountered, and the glow of Ether became the brilliance that lit her childhood.
"When I was little, I had three friends: the mighty black shield, the teleporting Thana, and the super-powerful great armor!"
"Then one day, they were gone..."
"But it's okay! I drew them in my notebook. Now, with just a wave of my staff, I can summon them all back!"
When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate.
Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo , stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.
02
Great Magician
Lately, a tale has been spreading through New Eridu about the Night Emissary.
"Every night at midnight, the Night Emissary shows up on the streets to tell us all kinds of stories!"
"She's also an amazing magician! Just by chanting a spell, there's a 'Woosh!' and she summons a whole swarm of Ethereals to fight for us!"
"Last time we got lost in a Hollow, the Night Emissary used that very trick to save us!"
—As told by Avocaboo, Devilboo and Boollseye.
While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring , Harmony deals 15% more DMG.
Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring .
03
The Best Partner
—Knock, knock knock. 
With the steady rhythm of knocks, a kebab was passed through the window.
"Proxy, take it! Hot off the fire — roast skewers with lemon popping candy, paired as perfectly as a Dullahan's sword and shield!"
"Once you finish eating... let's head out and play!"
"I have a feeling... tonight we'll find some amazing inspiration for an urban legend, the kind that can make the entire forum explode!"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Late-Night Hours
A Scholar of Urban Legends must have keen curiosity, plenty of drive, and the guts to set off without hesitation. Lucia is no exception.
That's why, during her early days in New Eridu, she became a regular at Public Security.
"How many times do I have to tell you? Chasing after ghost stories doesn't give you the right to wander into construction zones!"
"Don't sleep on the streets, don't run around in the middle of the night, and don't go diving into Hollows in front of everyone... These are all part of the 'Rules for Life in New Eridu,' and you need to take them seriously!"
"If you really can't sleep, then... uh, why not go explore Thymefield manor, and tell Alice a few ghost stories while you're there?"
When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
05
Dream Watcher
Night falls dark as ink, the stars shining bright and brilliant.
She journeys from afar, carrying stories, ballads, and unfinished verses.
She plucks a flower, dew gathered upon its petals, and sets it on the windowsill.
She watches over your dreams, keeping them warm and safe.
"Good morning... Huh? When did you get here, Lucia?"
"I'm not sure, but it hasn't been too long... time just seems to fly when I'm around you, Proxy."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
The Never-Ending Journey
Lucia's life is an endless journey. She runs beneath the moonlight, searching, crossing street after street, city after city.
Stories intertwine like threads, spinning endless dreams, while gentle song flows beneath the glow of the night lanterns.
Her search never stops, and under the stars, the journey goes on without end.
Only when the night fades and the sun rises does the girl step out of the Hollows, stretching lazily.
"Yaaawn... I'm so tired... but everyone says it's best not to sleep inside a Hollow..."
"Maybe I should just crash on the floor at the video store instead!"
When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil , her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.

Lore 
Miasma is a unique Ether -derived substance found in the Lemnian Hollow . Typically occurring as a liquid, it's highly active and corrupts the mind, causing madness and blurring the line between illusion and reality. Those who step into the Miasma become corrupted into Ethereals .

Special Gameplay [ ] 
All info is taken from the official HoYoLAB post Ridu Renovation Talk Vol. 4: Investigation Zone Gameplay Guide 
Miasmic Field and Miasma Shield [ ] 
Some enemies draw energy from Miasma to activate a special Miasmic Field while gaining a Miasma Shield . Within these special field, Proxies can use Perception Techniques to break down the Miasma coagulum and weaken the enemy's "Miasma Shield."
When certain bosses activate the Miasmic Field and gain a Miasmic Shield, they cannot be Stunned . During this time, Agent attacks can reduce the Miasmic Shield, and using certain Skills will increase [ sic ] the shield more effectively. When the Miasmic Shield is broken, enemies will take Purify DMG, Agents restore Energy or Adrenaline, and the surrounding Miasmic Field is cleared.
Miasma Tumors [ ] 
During exploration, Miasma Tumors may be blocking the way. Use Perception Techniques to break all nearby connected Miasma Cores to clear them.
Miasma Contamination [ ] 
Some Exploration Areas contain special Miasma enviroments. Engaging in combat or staying in these areas for an extended period will cause the team to continuously accumulate Miasma Contamination . When the Miasma Contamination value reaches its limit, all Agents will receive DMG based on a percentage of their current HP. Proxies can reduce Miasma Contamination buildup by either leaving the area or getting closer to the Miasma Purifier , and get close to a Fissure Beacon to instantly restore the whole squad's HP.
Some enemies' attacks carry the Miasma Corruption attribute. When these attacks hit an Agent, the squad will accumulate Miasma Contamination. Some enemies' skills can generate a special Miasma Pool , which adds additional effects on cerain enemy skills.
Loading Screen Tips [ ] 
Main article: Loading Screen 
New Eridu Wiki [ ] 
No.44: Miasma Origins
An Ether derivative unique to the Lemnian Hollow, one of the many forms of Ether. Also found in sectors connected to the Lemnian Hollow through fissures within Hollow Zero .
No.45: Miasma Properties
Miasma particles have potent hallucinogenic effects. Dense miasma often condenses into viscous liquid masses that cling to the ground, serving as breeding grounds for Ethereal entities.
No.46: Miasma Derivatives
When Miasma condenses and clusters together, it evolves into more complex structures like Miasma coagulum and Miasma Tumor, becoming even more dangerous.
Combat [ ] 
No.52: When [Miasma Contamination] reaches its maximum value, it deals DMG equal to a percentage of the current HP to all Agents in the team.
Hollow Investigation [ ] 
No.60: Inside the Miasmic Field, the Miasma barrier transforms into a Miasmic Shield and enhances Boss enemies. Use Disintegration to break the Miasmic Shield's weak points and weaken it.
No.65: Agents exposed to Miasma will suffer from Miasma Contamination. When it maxes, the whole squad will lose HP.
No.66: Miasma Contamination will gradually fade when moving away from the toxic fog. Getting close to a Miasma Purifier can also quickly remove the contamination status.
No.67: Some enemy skills will generate a Miasma Pool on the ground, which causes additional effects on certain enemy moves.

Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact 
Basic Attack 
Hold to launch a charged attack, dealing Ether DMG . Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 Downbeats .
After using a Chain Attack , Ultimate , or EX Special Attack , if enough Downbeats are available, hold to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, Chain Attacks , Ultimates , and EX Special Attacks do not interrupt the combo count of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact .
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.

Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by X .
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato .
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of Vibrato .
If Vibrato reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an Ether , Electric , Fire , Physical , Ice , or Wind Anomaly, or if the enemy has Vibrato and recovers from being Stunned, all Vibrato stacks will be cleared.
When Vibrato is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 720% / 360% / 900% / 63% / 90% / 36% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once Vibrato has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain Vibrato again.
When Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by A% , and her Daze dealt increases by B% , and all squad members' DMG dealt increases by C% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 Downbeats /s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 Downbeats . This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can hold up to 100 Downbeats , and starts with 30 Downbeats upon entering the battlefield.

When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. Chain Attacks against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of Dance Prowess , up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With Dance Prowess , when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love , Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact , or Quick Assist: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Quick Assist . Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder , Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess , the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact , which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next EX Special Attack will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of Dance Prowess will also be consumed to trigger Polarity Disorder on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or Ultimate: Meteor Shower hits an enemy, the enemy suffers Misstep . Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, Misstep can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Misstep recovers from Stun, the Misstep effect ends.

Toggle Text 
01
Lazy Spotlight
Dreams are such troublesome and expensive things. When the spotlight shines on her, it just feels a little warm, that's all. Honestly, watching Sunna blush from being teased, seeing Aria short-circuit from nerves, or discovering our next lucky break might be far more entertaining to her.
When EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's Downbeat is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
02
Painless Tears
Tears are a valuable stage prop, but unfortunately, she's always been short on stock. Luckily, her acting skills as an idol are good enough to make them fall right on cue when needed... whether it's to comfort a real crybaby, or win a little sympathy from the audience.
Each stack of Vibrato' s additional Abloom DMG ratio increase from Core Passive: Prodigious Idol increases by an additional 10%.
The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by Additional Ability: Angel Captain increases by an additional 30%.
When the active character's Chain Attack heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Polarity Disorder , dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Stun period.
03
Chips on the Scales
Choreography can be arranged, stage positions can be planned, and even popularity and the future seem like things money can sort out. Watching the numbers bounce around in the account feels like a reassuring little game... until a problem shows up with no price tag attached. Fiddling with the stack of "chips" she's best at using makes the scale of "it's just business" start to wobble.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Accomplice's Dance Step
I've got a habit of giving Sunna the most dazzling position on stage, and leaving Aria the high note that cuts through the night sky. My "dream" was borrowed from them, but the resolve to protect what I borrowed belongs entirely to me.
Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40.
The Anomaly Buildup of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact when hitting an enemy increases by 35%.
05
Center Stage
The Yearlight lanterns drift up into the sky, and the stage curtain finally opens. The stage, the lights, their faces... everything has never been this clear. Turns out I've been standing in the center of the spotlight all along. I was never just watching from the sidelines.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
An Angel's Delusion
Cameras, cheering crowds, glow sticks... that distant warmth turns into blazing fire. The dream I borrowed from others has already fused with my flesh and blood. From here on, this intoxicating "Delusion" will be defined by Captain Nangong.
Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze.

When hit by the heavy attack of Ultimate: Meteor Shower , they gain 2 stacks of Vibrato: Modified .
Vibrato: Modified can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all Vibrato: Modified stacks are cleared. When Vibrato: Modified is cleared, if the enemy is under an Ether , Electric , Fire , Physical , Ice , or Wind Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 800% / 400% / 1,000% / 70% / 100% / 40% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato: Modified on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%.
Vibrato: Modified cannot stack with Vibrato .

The New Eridu Defense Force (NEDF) is a military organization nominally under the New Eridu City Administration . The Defense Force has three main responsibilities: Deterring external threats, containing Hollows , and expanding into new territory.
The Defense Force operate Scott Outpost , helping protect New Eridu by containing Hollow Zero . They also work in conjunction with H.A.N.D. and take their place when a Hollow grows too unstable for H.A.N.D. to manage, mobilizing a strike team to quickly suppress the Hollow by eliminating every living creature inside it. Though the Defense Force is tied to city administration, they have been shown to be a de facto independent organization with many internal struggles, [ 1 ] and Mayor Mayflower has limited influence over the army leaders. [ 2 ] 
Rebel Soldiers are rogue members of the Defense Force who act for various private interests or have defected. "Rebel" is also used as a catch-all term for any citizens who opposes the Defense Force, regardless of their background.

Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across New Eridu Defense Force squads are considered to belong in one faction. For example, Soldier 11 's Additional Ability: Fields of Fire can activate with Soldier 0 - Anby , despite them being from different NEDF squads. 
Hierarchy & Members [ ] 
Typical Defense Force squads consist of light infantry (Jaegers), heavily-armored assault units (Gunners), and armed tactical mechs (Strikers, Rovers, Guardians, and Typhons).
Although Eridu Defense Force once had multiple divisions, all but the Obsidian Division were wiped out when the Old Capital was destroyed by Hollow Zero . [ 3 ]

New Eridu Public Security (NEPS) is a police organization under the New Eridu City Administration tasked with maintaining peace and order within New Eridu .
NEPS is responsible for most of New Eridu's administrative and judicial needs. They have branches all over the city, including an office at Lumina Square .

Departments [ ] 
Metropolitan Order Division [ ] 
Main article: Metropolitan Order Division 
Responsible for public order within the city. The Criminal Investigation Special Response Team conducts regular patrols, raises safety awareness, and deals with criminals such as Hollow Raiders , gangsters, fraudsters, and Proxies . 
General Affairs Department [ ] 
Processes most administrative forms and documents, and deals with general violations and daily order issues.
Traffic Department [ ] 
Deals with traffic-related issues such as vehicle violations and traffic document handling.
Hollow Affairs Department [ ] 
Responsible for Hollow -related issues. The Hollow Affairs Department keeps civilians away from Hollows within the city, and often enters Companion Hollows for rescue operations, criminal pursuits, or to assist the Hollow Investigative Association .
Gameplay Notes [ ] 
For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across New Eridu Public Security divisions are considered to belong in one Faction. For example, Jane Doe 's Additional Ability: Sore Spot can activate with Cissia , despite them being from different Factions. Likewise, Officer Cui 's Additional Ability: Provisional Security Canine had its text updated in Version 2.7 to say New Eridu Public Security instead of Criminal Investigation Special Response Team .

Trivia [ ] 
The official mascot of New Eridu Public Security is Officer Mewmew , who often appears on its flyers and other propaganda. Officers dressed as Mewmew patrol around many neighborhoods to award citizens for their "community contributions".
NEPS has been seen to use police dogs, with one, Eugene, being stationed at the NEPS Lumina Branch with his handler Benjamin.

The Nightwatchers are a tribe that lives on the outskirts of New Eridu , implied to reside in the Outer Ring . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] 
Contents
1 Overview 
2 History 
3 Known Members 
4 Gallery 
5 Other Languages 
6 Change History 
7 References 
8 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
The Nightwatchers are a tribe of goat Thirens that live outside of New Eridu. They are notable due to having a curse placed upon them in ages past - the Night Horror , a mysterious entity from the Hollows , caused the Nightwatchers to sleepwalk in to Hollows should they fall asleep at nigh. Due to this, the Nightwatchers have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle. If someone falls asleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn arrives. [ 3 ] However this curse also came with a blessing, that some Ethereals do not hunt members of the tribe. This allows them to more safely navigate Hollows, however it often invites scrutiny and suspicion from outsiders, leading to many members being ostracized by New Eridu's people.
The tribe possesses a staff that can create illusions of Ethereals and mimic their abilities. It is the only surviving weapon from their ancestors' battle against the Night Horror. For decades, chieftains have used it to fend off particularly dangerous Ethereals and protect the tribe from Hollow disasters. The staff is currently wielded by Lucia , and was given to her by the chieftain . [ 4 ] 
History [ ] 
The exact origins of the tribe are unknown, but it is possible that they existed as far back as 10,000 years ago. [ 5 ] 
Long ago, the ancestors of the Nightwatchers once fought a powerful Ethereal known as the Night Horror for days on end. Right before the Night Horror fell, it released a surge of power, which cursed the Nightwatchers to dream of the Night Horror when sleeping at night. This would make them sleepwalk into Hollows, regaining consciousness only for a brief moment before they turned into Ethereals. However, it also gave them ability to be perceived by Ethereals as their kin, and thus be unbothered by them. [ 6 ] 
Another version of the legend states that the tribe deliberately hunted down the Night Horror to seize its power of controlling other Ethereals. When the Night Horror unleashed its final surge of energy, half of the tribe immediately turned into Ethereals, and the other half was forced to defeat them. This sacrifice of their own people was the only reason they were acknowledged by the Hollow and received the gift-curse. [ 7 ] 
During the Fall of the Old Capital , the tribe were left imperiled due to the Companion Hollows ravaging the land at the time, and as they were not considered proper citizens of New Eridu, Public Security offered them no assistance, forcing them to fend for themselves. Though the Nightwatchers ultimately survived the catastrophe, they suffered numerous casualties. Years later, when Phaethon first met Lucia , a Nightwatcher named Kieran had plans to betray the tribe, having grown embittered due to the discrimination he faced due to being part of the tribe. He hoped to steal the staff entrusted to Lucia, and abduct a unique Hati named Chestnut that was affectionate towards her, sending them to unknown allies of his in New Eridu who hoped to study them for their own ends, and also had the chieftain fall asleep, making him sleepwalk in to the Lemnian Hollow . His plans were ultimately thwarted and the cheiftan was saved.

Basic Attack: Hat Trick 
Basic Attack 
When Norma is the active character and is in combat, she gains 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Top Hat Companion is on her head, hold to activate:
After firing, Norma throws out Top Hat Companion , ordering it to unleash a round of aerial fire, dealing Fire DMG and storing the current Preheated Chamber .
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's Quick Assist . This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Once Top Hat Companion has been thrown out, it will accumulate and retain Preheated Chamber at the same speed on behalf of Norma. Norma does not need to stay on the field during this period.
After Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion , she immediately gains the stored Preheated Chamber .
When holding , the Top Hat Companion will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the Top Hat Companion would raise Preheated Chamber to 80% or higher, the Top Hat Companion will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if Preheated Chamber is not full, Top Hat Companion automatically enters the battlefield.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

01
Visionary Extremism
Advance! By any means necessary!
Too many things are chasing us in this dying world: the pitch-black frontier, our fleeting lifespan.
Human life and civilization are more fragile than a Bangboo's logic core.
The only way to stay ahead of destruction is to keep moving forward, by any means necessary.
"Besides, the first to witness a new horizon always sees the most beautiful view, don't they?"
The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment increases to 12s.
When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s.
02
Axiom of Universal Unity
The world of physicists is constantly overturned by new theories. The order ordinary people rely on is just as often shattered by unexpected events and conflict.
The ties that bind all things are always mysterious, both incredibly intimate and incredibly fragile, impossible to fully comprehend.
"Bring Bangboo and Roscaelifer to greater heights? You mean 'the byproduct of chasing curiosity,' right?"
The Stun DMG Multiplier granted by each stack of Tech Divide in Norma's Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers is increased to 6%.
When Norma uses Basic Attack: Hat Trick while in combat, she gains 25 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
03
Natural-Born Villain Paradox
It's another calm, peaceful day in Roscaelifer, with clear skies and a gentle breeze.
But for the Bangboo, there may still be one ultimate supervillain...
"Why is it that the smartest genius in every kids' cartoon always ends up becoming the bad guy...?"
"Seriously, what's so great about those crazy scientists whose budget and hairline are both hanging on by a thread?"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Bangboo Superiority Theory
Without a doubt, Bangboo are the most loyal companions humanity has had in the past century, the most efficient tools, and perhaps even... the most powerful weapons.
Like any child yet to be taught or any blade yet to find a worthy owner, a Bangboo can serve anyone, whether it's the righteous Phaethon or the most ruthless villain.
"First of all, I'm a pacifist who happens to love Bangboo."
"Second, part of my job is making sure the sharpest sword stays in our hands."
When Norma consumes Preheated Chamber to trigger a Chain Attack , both Norma and the corresponding Agent gain 200 Decibels.
05
En-Nah Big Bang
According to archived External Strategy Department records, a project led by the young researcher Norma rapidly pushed the performance limits of mass-produced Bangboo to new heights.
Before being promoted to Chief Technician of the ESD, Norma's most important assignment was proving that she wouldn't one day launch Booastrum into orbit.
"Higher! Faster! Stronger!"
"The only things limiting imagination are courage and the R&D budget!"

06
The Primary Cause of Genius
Every great creation begins with curiosity and a happy accident. Perhaps the birth of the very first Bangboo soul was nothing more than Lady Sunbringer's fascination with the mysteries of life.
After any squad member Stuns an enemy, Norma will continuously summon missiles to bombard random enemies on the field for 6s. A missile is launched every 0.75s, dealing Fire DMG equal to 200% of Norma's ATK to enemies within the area. This DMG is considered Ultimate DMG. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
The Daze inflicted by Armor-Piercing Warhead increases by 30% , and the DMG dealt by High-Explosive Warhead increases by 30% .

Etymology [ ] 
Obols were silver coins used in ancient Greece. When a person died, an obol was traditionally placed in the corpse's mouth to pay Charon for passage to the Greek underworld .

Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by X% , and Aftershock DMG increases by X% .
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by X . When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed X . When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

01
Luxurious Cat House
The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"
Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's Fire RES , and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
02
Weird Food List
Sea grape popcorn, sakura peach seafood porridge, spicy strawberry braised tofu... Orphie sometimes tries foods with bizarre flavors, all chaotically listed on the list at the corner of her desk.
"While tasty food is tempting, interesting flavors are worth trying too! ...Just as long as they're not bitter!"
"Hey Proxy, wanna try my favorite ultra-spicy strawberry coconut candy? I've already unwrapped it for you—"
"Soldier Orphie, your weird tastes are gonna scare away all your friends one day!"
When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s. After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.
03
"Tactics Manual"
No one knows what's written in the "Tactics Manual: Orphie's Special Extension" sitting on the young lady's bedside table, not even Captain Magus...
"'Annihilation-1', 'Retreat-3', 'Patrol-2'... Oh, and 'Social Rendezvous-5'!"
"Hold up, Orphie, since when did the tactical strategies for social rendezvous expand to five entries?!"
"I was just testing if you were familiar enough with the Tactics Manual, hehe! You passed, Captain!"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Pink Holster
Magus never responds to empty threats, which is exactly why Orphie actually bought a pink holster.
It sits in the bottom drawer of the storage locker, serving as a constant reminder for Magus to watch her words — though with limited success.
"Captain, I've told you before, think thrice before speaking, or you'll end up hurting others!"
"Those punks deserved those bullets! Wait, Orphie... Squad Member Orphie, I order you to put that horrendously pink thing down!"
Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.
05
Ferry Toll
It was Orphie who placed the silver, gleaming commemorative coin right at the entrance where anyone could see it.
"Where could that silver coin for crossing the River of the underworld be~"
"How about... making a set of commemorative coins like this? Using the squad emblem as the design, as a symbol of our squad spirit."
"So a badge of moonlight can be born from black flames...?"
"Stop saying things nobody understands, Soldier 11! But Trigger's idea is great! We could even put all the squad members' names on the back! What do you think, Captain?"
"Approved."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Magic Seed
"Captain, this kind of seed won't grow into a flower. Just like me... no matter how hard I try, nothing ever comes of it..."
"Orphie, this is a magic seed. Though it can't bloom or sprout on its own, it helps other seeds grow into mighty trees... Just keep it with you, and it will bring you good fortune."
"Like me, it will always stay by your side, Orphie, watching as you gradually become the finest soldier."
—Facing that tiny figure who clumsily wipes away tears with her palms, her face twisted with hurt and sadness, Magus's voice flowed from her muzzle with a gentleness never heard before.
With enough energy, after the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex. When the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower is activated, recover 10 Bottled Heat, and the Interrupt Level during the low firepower phase of EX Special Attack: Heat Charge will also increase. When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge or Ultimate hits enemies, it deals additional Fire DMG equal to 250% of Orphie & Magus's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and is counted as EX Special Attack and Aftershock DMG.

01
Qi Shield
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.
All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi .
02
Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"
For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
03
Non-Meridian Pressure Point
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
First-Class Head Chef
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

"Thiren"
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

Perception Technique is an exploration mechanic used in Investigation Zone Mode . It is the special technique of Yunkui Summit . [ 1 ] To use it, the Proxy must press or hold on the target.

Overview [ ] 
The Perception Technique allows for the specific usage and manipulation of Ether depending on which form the user performs. [ 1 ] 
Forms [ ] 
There are four known forms of the Perception Technique:
Disintegration — forcibly disrupting the resonance frequency of Ether [ 1 ] 
Insight — tracking lingering traces of Ether nearby [ 1 ] 
Revelation — finding anomalies in the Hollows [ 1 ] 
Retrace — removing the Miasma 's influence and alter the state of the corrupted object [ 2 ]

The Disintegration Ability Aim your crosshair at the Weak Point of the corrupted matter , then press to destroy the targeted weak point .
When all weak points on the surface of the corrupted matter are destroyed, the corrupted matter will collapse on its own.
The Revelation Ability Aim your crosshair at the unstable structure , press to alter its Ether frequency, switching it to a state of "Revelation" or dispelling the illusion .
The Insight Ability Aim your crosshair at the "clue" , and hold to track Ether Traces and find the next clue. While this ability is active, normal interactions will be disabled.

A well-known Proxy in New Eridu , known for their unique guidance technology and extremely high commission success rate. [ 1 ] 
Phaethon is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . Phaethon is the alias of a legendary Proxy in New Eridu , who in actuality is a team comprising Wise and Belle . The siblings are commonly referred to as "Proxy" or "Manager" by people they know, the latter referring to their public business as the managers of Random Play .
Contents
1 Profile

4 Other Languages

Profile [ ] 
Wise and Belle utilize their exclusive Hollow Deep Dive System , a device constructed from ancient technology found in the Hollows . [ 2 ] The copyright for this system is later revealed to be owned by the Helios Academy , [ 3 ] and one of the many achievements of Carole Arna . [ 4 ] 
Using the H.D.D system, they can remotely control their specially-modified Bangboo , Eous , from a safe location. [ 5 ] This capability has significantly contributed to their popularity, earning them a reputation as a "Proxy who doesn't enter the Hollows themselves, but manages real-time communication from the outside," a feat previously thought impossible due to how the Hollows interfere with communications. Additionally, by controlling Eous from the outside, they can update their Hollow data in real-time, ensuring that the "Carrot" (Hollow map) doesn't become obsolete while their clients are inside the Hollow. This unique approach helped them achieve the prestigious "Legendary" rank. [ 6 ] 
During the events of the prologue , the Phaethon Inter-Knot account was hacked by White Noise . Left with no other choice, Wise and Belle handed over the account information to Public Security, also losing a large portion of their collected Hollow Data in the process. Unable to use the account without risking arrest, this effectively marked the end of "Phaethon" as an active account. [ 7 ] 
Despite the Phaethon account no longer being accessible, Wise and Belle's reputation endured. Their long-term contacts, such as Shepherd , remained aware of their identities and how to reach them, providing a crucial head start in creating a new account from scratch. The subsequent addition of the AI Fairy , with her ability to access any and all connected devices within New Eridu , ensured they always had the most up-to-date Hollow data. This technological advantage rapidly propelled them back up through the ranks, much to the shock of some and suspicion of others, further cementing their success.

Trivia [ ] 
The artwork composition of Vivian 's vision might be a reference to the 1588 Dutch engraving of the fall of Phaethon , with the protagonist in the same pose as the mythological Phaethon.
The addition of wings might be a reference to the fall of Icarus , another Greek mythological figure who fell from the sky. He escaped the labyrinth of Crete with wings made of beeswax and bird feathers, but ignored his father's warnings and flew too close to the sun, the warmth of which melted the wax, making the feathers fall out and leaving Icarus with bare arms, plummeting into the sea while his feathers danced in the air like snowflakes.
Both myths are meant to be a warning towards hubris , the arrogance to dare go against natural order and try to be at the same level of the gods.
It is implied that "Phaethon" was a name given to the siblings by Carole Arna , prior to their careers as Proxies. [ 8 ] 
Etymology [ ] 
Phaethon was the son of Helios, god of the Sun, who tried driving his father's Sun chariot with such disastrous results that he died: sources differ if he fell to his death into the river Eridanus or was struck by Zeus as a punishment.
Interestingly, the Lore Teaser - "Where the Miracle Began" quotes in the background "Here lies Phaethon who in the Sun-God chariot fared. And though greatly he failed more greatly he dared," which is the translation by Edith Hamilton in Mythology: Timeless Tales of Gods and Heroes of the epitaph on Phaethon's tomb, as told in Ovid's version of the myth, lines 327-328 .
