Toggle Text 
01
Lingering Pain and Thrilling Procession
Chasing the limits, savoring the pain, stumbling onward along the trail left by old wounds, as if they might lead to a fleeting moment of truly being alive.
Pain beats the drum for the march, while the heart provides the only applause that never ends.
Upon entering the battlefield, Phoenix gains 1 point of Ascension . In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The CRIT DMG of Anomaly DMG dealt to enemies in the Sear state is increased by an additional 25%.
When a Combustion Attack deals DMG, Pyre generation efficiency increases by 15%.
02
Curiosity Won't Kill the Cat
They say cats have nine lives, so they can climb the highest rooftops without a care.
She likes to walk on tiptoe too, and if one step finds nothing beneath it, the long fall is merely another unremarkable adventure.
Following the trail of clues danger leaves behind, she keeps moving forward, with the end of the story forever out of reach.
When Phoenix applies Burn to an enemy, its duration is increased by 2s.
Phoenix's DMG against enemies in the Sear state increases by 30%.
03
Scarecrow Complex
With the steady tick-tock of her heartbeat, she wakes again beneath a ceiling that feels at once familiar and unfamiliar.
She listens as the nurse tells her a distant fairy tale: at the end of life lies a town above the clouds, cut off from the world behind towering walls. There are no worries or fears there, no pain or sorrow.
Carefree scarecrows make their home there, living quietly and happily, day after day. For they have no feelings and no love. They have lost their shadows and their hearts as well.
She listens intently, as though recognizing an invitation she has rejected countless times before.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Life's End and the Heartless Wonderland
She has reached the end of life countless times. There is no town above the clouds, no scarecrows who have lost their hearts. There is only a towering wall, asking if she would trade her shadow and her heart for eternal peace.
She touches her shadow. Her heart is there, beating awkwardly, stubbornly. She still has a shadow. She wants to hold on to her heart.
So she enters the deep forest again and again, and each time, she turns back at the very end. Even if there is no sunlight, no refuge, only thorns, wounds, and an exile without end.
That's okay. She's used to it by now. Even if she can never arrive, she can at least keep searching.
When the Finishing Move of Soul-Searching Blaze or Basic Attack: Purifying Flame hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers 1 additional instance of Abloom , resolving the corresponding Attribute Anomaly DMG at a fixed 600% multiplier.
05
Carnival of Madness
The world is a stage, and everyone has a part to play in the story of their life. She is no different.
She is the helpless patient and the righteous judge; a capricious executioner, a reckless adventurer; a child fascinated by everything, a strange soul indifferent to pain...
She can be anyone. But none of those people are Phoenix.
She embraces everyone but herself. She delights in death, yet has never truly known what it means to live.
But that stopped mattering long ago. The show must go on, and she has only one thing to do: choose a mask and start playing herself.
So why not play a circus clown? Always making a scene, always laughing out loud.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Notes From Confinement
She still asks the dead of night for one grand fall, still loves the sound of the wind tearing past her ears.
She still embraces the thorns, letting the world's sharp edges pierce her flesh, letting her blood follow the tracks of days gone by into the abyss.
But this time, the thorns don't fall back into the soil.
Someone barges into her little garden without so much as asking, picks up the branches she's left behind, winds them around the gate and window frames, and builds a crooked little fence. Then they stand before her, blocking the desolate path ahead.
She hesitates time and again, but finally takes a step back.
Phoenix ignores 15% of the targets' All-Attribute RES.
When Phoenix uses EX Special Attack: Dazzling Flare , she gains 1 point of Ascension .
Abloom effects triggered by Phoenix ignore 40% of enemy DEF.

01
Leisure Moment
One ordinary morning at Sons of Calydon, Piper lets out a lazy yawn. "Good morning—"
"Can we have another relaxing day today? It's important to take it easy, or else lil ol' me might end up working meself to death—"
When Piper’s Special Attack: Tire Spin, EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, or Ultimate hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of Power. The maximum stack limit of Power is increased to 30.
02
Motivation
A bit of effort now means more rest later.
Though, it'd be even better if I didn't have to put in any effort at all — Piper stretches, pats the soft bed in her truck, and lies down.
During Special Attack: Tire Spin and EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, Piper’s movement speed increases. When using Special Attack: One Trillion Tons, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy, or Ultimate to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Physical DMG dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For every stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.
03
Truck Expert
Piper is always all about trucks.
Even when she's fast asleep, the rumble of an engine snaps her awake in an instant: "100 horsepower, 5-ton capacity... must be the new light truck from Three Gates Industries!"
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Refined Techniques
Riding with Piper is a heart-pounding experience.
By the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
She always gets you to your destination fast—though your nerves might take a hit.
Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger every 30s.
05
Personal Hobbies
Piper seems to have some hobbies that are not what you'd expect from her.
"This horse looks like a real runner... Hmm, but not many people are betting on it. Guess the one with the higher win rate is the safer bet..."
"Burp— Nitro-Fuel... I can drink more... Gimme another one!"
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv.+2
06
Mild Excitement
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert. "If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder.
Increases the duration limit of EX Special Attack: Engine Spin by 2s and extends the duration of Power by 4s.

title: Porcelume
text:
Porcelume
Type
Lore 
Porcelume is an Ether -resistant material mined and refined from Lumite Ore in Aerospace City . [ 1 ] It is used to produce various objects, including Qingyi 's body parts, Jane Doe 's daggers and bootblades, and Evelyn Chevalier 's Lunalux Garrote. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ]

Properties [ ] 
Structural Composition [ ] 
Porcelume is noted from research notes to have great insulation, a resistance to high temperatures, noncombustibility, good malleability, and is inert to electrical energy, photonic energy, and high impact. It is a highly stable nonmetal with high reflectivity. [ 5 ] 
Porcelume can be combined with certain metals to form the composite Flint Porcelloy . [ 6 ] 
Societal Applications [ ] 
Porcelume has great capacity to absorb Ether, and pharmaceuticals created using it as the primary component showed the ability to greatly reduce and even cure Ether Corruption. [ 7 ] 
Due to its hardness and resilience, as well as immunity to Ether corruption compared to other metal alloys, it is seen as an incredibly viable material for weapons, equipment coating and drill heads in ore extraction. [ 8 ] 
Shortcomings [ ] 
While Porcelume is great at absorbing Ether, it is also exceedingly difficult to release the Ether, meaning it was not suitable for energy storage. Additionally all forms of Porcelume have an indeterminate threshold for Ether storage. Because the Ether stored within Porcelume does not dissipate, when it exceeds its limit it causes a physical shift that can result in an Etheric meltdown. [ 9 ] 
Illnesses [ ] 
Ether Vacuum [ ] 
Due to Porcelume's ability to absorb Ether at a high rate, in certain circumstances it can create an Ether vacuum, which has the express ability to lower a person's Ether resistance. [ 10 ] 
Porcelume Rejection [ ] 
A sickness found in appearing in people treated for Ether corruption with Porcelume medicine. Their bodies violently reject Porcelume in their bodies, creating antibodies to attack the mineral. This results in a high fever and luminescent rashes whenever the afflicted interacts with Porcelume from then on. [ 11 ] 
Porcelume Lung [ ] 
Inhaling excessive Porcelume dust can result in lung fibrosis. The microcrystalline structure of Porcelume causes it to accumulate in the lungs, physically blocking alveolar Ether exchange, leading to chronic dry cough and breathing difficulties. [ 12 ] 
Trivia [ ] 
Etymology [ ] 
Porcelume is a portmanteau of "porcelain" ( Chinese : 瓷 ), and "lume" ( Chinese : 辉 ) from the latin "lumen," meaning "light." This name was coined in-game by "Sunbringer" . [ 5 ]

Toggle Text 
01
Innocent Idealism
This is a chaotic, lawless land.
Roaring engines and swirling dust, steel clashing with flesh. Conflict and violence play out day and night.
An innocent child grips an equally innocent weapon, wandering the same lost red earth.
"Would you be willing to do your part for the peace here?"
When Promeia uses Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement , she gains an additional effect: if Trial by Cold points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of Trial by Cold . This effect can trigger once after using Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement .
When any squad member triggers Abloom on enemies with Presumption of Guilt , it ignores an additional 20% DEF.
02
Faltering Conviction
She became an exceptional Sweeper — swift, precise, and silent. Her targets were clear and countless: Ethereals, those infected with irreversible Corruption, those fated to turn into Ethereals... every kill marked by bloodshed and the echoes of their cries.
But... is it right?
"This is a Sweeper's duty!" "Just think of it as... for the greater good, got it?" "Those people were going to die anyway." ...
"It's a necessary sacrifice."
Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40.
The multiplier of Abloom triggered by consuming Trial by Cold increases by 120%.
03
Cruel Moonlight
The truth is often carved out from an unremarkable accident.
"You think the Sweepers could get rich just by dealing with worthless Ethereals?"
"Gang wars are a guaranteed profit. If you're afraid of getting your hands dirty, the 'Black Wolf' is more than eager..."
Night fell soon after, earlier than anyone expected.
The Sweepers, Calydon, the gangs with names and those without... in this chaotic age, all seemed to vanish into the endless dark.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Ruthless Accusation
An invitation arrived, summoning a moth to its judgment.
The right to choose, light, justice, and everything that made her "Promeia."
She put on the handcuffs and chose exile for herself.
"This is my final choice."
When Promeia triggers Abloom , she restores 5 Corrosive Chill . This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
05
The Dying Moth
She buried herself in her work.
Investigations, interrogations, judgments... an endless list.
Her colleagues watched her with concern.
"How long are you going to keep this up...?"
"Until every last sin is atoned for... or until death takes me."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
To Be Continued
The end didn't arrive as expected, and the night wasn't as dark as imagined.
Colleagues, old acquaintances, late-night lights, and new friends...
The poor moth still couldn't shake off these heavy gifts, and that long-awaited ending now felt even further away.
But maybe... such a fate isn't so bad.
When Promeia consumes Trial by Cold to trigger Abloom , it triggers an additional special Abloom effect, dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 Corrosive Chill and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s.
In addition, Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.

Mindscape Cinema [ ]

Toggle Text 
01
Self-Interest
"Self-interest is an instinct, but it can also be learned over time."
"How do you learn it?"
"Get burned a few times and you'll figure it out."
When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap , increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.
02
Opportunistic
"A mercenary's most valuable trait isn't loyalty - it's knowing when an opportunity appears. Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"
"Too many people let their emotions get the better of them. See? That's why they're all just losers who don't know their own lack of worth."
While in the Hunter's Gait state from Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct , Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.
03
Territorial
There's a large note posted on the door of Pulchra's car. Written in big red letters: THIS IS MY TURF! KNOCK BEFORE ENTERING! KNOCK! KNOCK!
Below it, there's a slightly smaller note with big black letters that reads: Caesar, you'd better pay for breaking my lock! 100,000 Dennies!
Under the black letters, there's a crooked line of small text: I asked Proxy, lock's only worth 20,000!
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Joy of the Hunt
"What's the point of challenging strong opponents? I'm not a masochist. For me, the real joy of the hunt comes when I know I'm gonna win!"
5 minutes later...
"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."
Reduces Energy Cost of activating EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.
05
Tail Game
Pulchra's earliest blurry childhood memory was of a warm, big tail. When she first learned to crawl, she loved to chase after it.
"And then what?"
"They tell me it was my own tail."
But Pulchra knew it wasn't hers. Aside from the tail game, at night, it would wrap tightly around her, keeping her warm through each cold night. Maybe the Hollow took it, or maybe something else... But it doesn't matter - she stopped playing that game long ago.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Behind the Mask
The respirator mask blocks out Ether particles and pollen, and shields her from curious, fearful, or malicious gazes — but it makes it impossible to curl up and get a good night's sleep. How she longs to find a warm place and take a carefree afternoon nap...
The car door suddenly swings open without warning. Startled awake, she instantly grabs her old partner and straps it to her face. "Would it kill you to knock?!"
...Ah, right. She can actually take it off now.
Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2.
Additional Ability: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.

Core Passive: Radiant Chariot 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 Solar Prominence. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of Solar Prominence , and Pyrois also gains 0.5 Solar Prominence every second while in combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gain 30 Solar Prominence and enter the Mirage state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence hold during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enter the Sunflare state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, and DMG dealt increases by X% , and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: Heavy attacks that hit enemies in the Contamination state deal Y% of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: Heavy attacks that hit Stunned enemies trigger the Totalize effect, dealing Z% of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. When the Finishing Move hits, the enemy's Stun state ends.

Introduced in Version 2.7 - Champions Never Fall to the Past • Released in Version 3.0 - A Sleepwalker's Confession 
[ Edit History ]
Version 3.1 
In the Agent selection menu, Pyrois's animation was changed, and Phaethon was added alongside them.
Pyrois's voice over in the agent selection menu was changed, and Phaethon also speaks with them.
While playing as Pyrois or viewing Pyrois in the Agent selection menu, Phaethon appears as the sibling the player last chose, wears their currently selected outfit , as well as any equipped accessories .
Two new Agent Focus: Pyrois were made accessible, allowing players to unlock Mindscapes 03 "Chains of Fate" and 04 "Balefire Horizon".
Version 3.0 
Pyrois was released as a playable agent.
Players can only obtain two Agent Focus: Pyrois at this time, as such only Mindscapes 01 "Shadows of Twilight Past" and 02 "Blazing Cavalry" can be unlocked.
Version 2.7 
Pyrois announced as an upcoming agent.

Qingming Sword is a weapon in Zenless Zone Zero . It is a jian and one of the Void Hunter Weapons , served as the most prized relic of Yunkui Summit . Its wielders are called Qingming Sword Keepers, and the sword comes with a Qingming Sword Manual. [ 1 ] It is currently wielded by Ye Shunguang .
Contents
1 Overview 
2 History 
3 Users 
4 Gallery 
5 Trivia 
5.1 Etymology 
6 Other Languages 
7 Change History 
8 References 
9 Navigation 
Overview [ ] 
The Qingming Sword contains two opposing forces that constantly battle, generating enough destructive energy to cause a disaster on par with the Fall of the Old Capital . To prevent the energy from leaking into the world outside, The Qingming Sword Keepers act as mediators, granting the Sword Keepers the ability of a Void Hunter for a short duration, which comes at the cost of gradually consuming the user's five senses and memories with each use. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] However, Ye Shunguang fully mastered the Qingming Sword, and has, for the meantime, shown no sign of having negative side effects. [ 4 ] 
Every High Preceptor receives the sword as a symbol of their position. When its wielder dies, the sword's power goes berserk and affects everything in its vicinity. [ 1 ] 
The Qingming Sword and The Creator share the same origin. [ 5 ] As such, the Creator is able to absorb the Qingming Sword's power, while the Qingming Sword is able to kill the Creator. [ 4 ] It is also why the negative effects of the Qingming Sword is able to be lifted through the Creator's power. [ 5 ] 
History [ ] 
Legend has it that it was first discovered near the Lemnian Hollow, originally a bizarre object feeding on the Ether within human bodies, until a powerful master with incredible control over Ether suppressed its rampage. Unable to find a way to destroy it, they forged it into a sword, leading to the establishment of the Yunkui Summit sect. [ 6 ] From then on, the Qingming Sword chose its master, acting as both a blessing and a curse.
Alongside the acquirement of the Qingming Sword, two parts of an ancient prophecy came with it "When darkness shrouds this land, all things wither, and songs of sorrow fall silent, only Bai Ze wielding the Qingming blade can break through the long night and awaken the dawn," and "The path of Bai Ze is never walked alone. When fate shifts, shadow follows light. Blessing and curse, joy and grief — one thought leads to heaven, the next to the abyss." [ 7 ] 
In recent times, the Qingming Sword had chosen Yijiang as its new master, while the health of previous one, the eleventh High Preceptor, was slowly deteriorating as the aftermath of using the Qingming Sword. To prevent her sister to meet the same fate and instead live a long and happy life, Yixuan , together with Yijiang herself, developed a new technique called the Qingming Bird. [ 3 ] However, when faced with the disaster of the expanding Hollow Zero, Yijiang chose to sacrifice herself and save her sister (and Eridu with her) from calamity. [ 3 ] 
After the Fall of the Old Capital, the orphaned Ye siblings got taken in by Lu Hengzhou of Yunkui Summit. [ 8 ] While Ye Shiyuan struggled at the beginning of his training, Ye Shunguang showed an incredible talent. [ 9 ] So, under Lu Hengzhou's manipulation, Ye Shunguang was brought towards the Qingming Sword, which brought her to be chosen by it. [ 8 ] Fearing that tragedy will repeat itself, Yixuan gifted her a sword case she crafted to suppress the side effects of the Qingming Sword, sealing it away, and put her in constant training in order to keep her away from dangerous missions. [ 6 ] Shiyuan, who swore to free his sister from the curse, first tried to shift the Qingming Sword's side effects onto himself instead, [ 10 ] then left to look for a definitive solution after Shunguang had unsheathed the sword to save him from the Creator's control. [ 11 ] 
When the Creator possessed Ye Shiyuan, Ye Shunguang used the Qingming Sword's power to repel the Creator's power, revealing that the Qingming Sword can battle against Them. [ 11 ] As the Creator's oncoming descent caused Ether fluctuations throughout Lemnian Hollow, Ye Shunguang used the Qingming Sword to the point of losing all of her senses. [ 12 ] Eventually, using the remnant power of the Creator, Phaethon was able to guide the power towards Ye Shunguang, having her recover all her senses. [ 5 ] 
When fighting against the Messenger of the Creator, Ye Shunguang fully mastered the Qingming Sword without any negative side effects, fulfulling the role of Bai Ze. [ 4 ] For this feat, Ye Shunguang was awarded by Mayor Mayflower the title of Void Hunter . [ 13 ]

Etymology [ ] 
青溟剑 Qīngmíng-jiàn literally means "Azure Sea Sword" in Chinese.
Qingming Sword's name is most likely derived from the Qingming Sword ( Chinese : 青冥劍 Qīngmíng-jiàn , "Azure Dark/Underworld Sword" ), which was a legendary sword that appeared in the State of Wu during the Spring and Autumn period of China, and the sword was believed to be lost in the Han Dynasty. [ 14 ] The sword currently exists in literature only, especially in fantasy works.
In the 2000 movie Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon , the sword is owned by the male protagonist, Li Mubai, and is called "Green Destiny" in the English translation.

Flash Connect 
Basic Attack 
When Qingyi deals Electric DMG with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage . When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms , Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage .
This skill does not feature any scaling.

Toggle Text 
01
Insulation Breakdown
"While there will be no threat to your life, we kindly request you do not resist arrest..."
The direction and intensity of the current have been precisely calculated to ensure that every suspect receives a safe electric shock experience.
When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%.
When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms , if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
02
Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
An ancient combat technique mentioned in old texts. It seems to have started as a martial arts technique, rather than a staff technique.
"Don't be so constrained, the arm itself can be used like a three-section staff, mhm."
The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value.
When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
03
Drink Hot Water
"Young people should be mindful their health, and drinking more hot water is a good start."
Qingyi always appears comforted when she drinks from her thermos. But be careful if she offers you a drink—
"Even 100-degree Celcius boiling water doesn't faze her..." One Public Security Officer who encountered this left such a note.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Stable Arc Barrier
By reverse-engineering Automatons from the old civilization, the White Star Institute developed the Arc Barrier, a technology that combines defense, attack, and electrical energy conversion.
"As the saying goes: Water can float a boat or sink it. Physics has a saying: Electric current flows like water. Therefore: Electric current can be used both offensively and defensively. It's a fantastic combination."
Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP.
If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
05
Youthful Spirit
"Great, young people should be courageous and try new things. Keep it up!"
It sometimes feels like Qingyi's encouragement is lazy and teasing, but if you really get into trouble, just rely on her.
After all, she's been around for centuries and can handle anything.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Eight Meridians
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"
The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%.
When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms , the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.

She is also the Lieutenant Colonel of the Guard of Staves, and was one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of " Void Hunter " with her title being "Void Hunter: Temporal Lumiflux."

The Garden of Diverging Time

The Long Goodbye
She awakens to a pale, desolate world
A hundred years is a dream too long. Long enough for the mists to swallow the remnants of a bygone age. Long enough for pale silence to smother the lingering warmth in her memory.
A hundred years is a dream too short. Short enough that the smile before parting still reflects in her eyes. Short enough that her fingertips still reach for a fleeting dance.
Then she remembers a summer night. The star-filled sky they once gazed upon together. So she begins to dance alone, just as she always has.

To an old friend. To a bygone age.

For the purposes of Faction -based effects, all Agents across Roscaelifer departments are considered to belong in one faction. This is known because Ultra Jake 's Additional Ability description states that the ability activates if there are Roscaelifer Agents in the squad, but it is not restricted to specifically External Strategy Department Agents, for example.

Roscaelifer Merchant Delegation , also known as the Merchant Association , is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . It represents the interests of merchants and businesses throughout Roscaelifer .

Description [ ] 
Officially operating under the supervision of the Administrative Affairs Department , the Merchant Association provides consultation and resource procurement services for businesses that pay to become members. [ 1 ] The Association is led by Violet , who inherited the position from a prior, unknown individual. She also serves as a member of the Council of Representatives with the interest of improving the Association's standing and ability to help its members. As is typical in Roscaelifer, Bangboo run businesses are able to become members without issue.
Currently the following businesses are known to be members of the Merchant Association:

Toggle Text 
01
Versatile Attendant
Roxy always manages to keep everything perfectly in order, from the head of the household's daily needs to her frequent whims.
"If you insist on going, please take this guide with you. Yes, I knew you would make this decision, milady."
"You've changed your mind? That's fine. Here's another guide, just for this sort of situation."
When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
02
Clocking Out Myth
Roxy's pale complexion and ever-present dark circles speak to how much effort she pours into the workshop.
She is all too familiar with Vyrium at four in the morning, despite having no nocturnal habits.
To her, clocking out feels as distant as a myth.
"Ah... dawn again... It feels like getting off work will never become a reality."
EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze.
For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow} , up to 3 stacks.
During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill , if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow . Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.
03
Tales of Insomnia
Roxy is used to making thorough plans, but whenever Claret is involved, those plans struggle to keep up with the changes. Countless schedule adjustments, countless revisions...
Even the perfect assistant eventually starts to lose her patience until she reaches a certain breaking point — and snaps.
From then on, Vyrium gains a terrifying figure who roams the streets late at night.
"I just want to go home... and get a good night's sleep—!"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
R.I.P.
Whenever Roxy brings out her weapon, her enemies are always left baffled: Who uses a coffin as a weapon?
Their confusion never lasts long, though.
Once they see the girl casually swing it around, tearing through the air with a heavy howl, they quickly understand: that thing definitely wasn't made for sleeping in.
"It's still daytime, but I'm afraid... it's time to say goodnight."
When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill.
When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill.

05
Second Heartbeat
Roxy can barely remember the adventure she had as a child, and the pain of losing her heart has long since faded.
But she will never forget how the girl known as a genius once cried until her proud eyes were red, calling Roxy's name over and over.
Her tears fell upon Roxy's cold chest, almost hot enough to burn a hole through her heart.
"Because of this Porcelloy Heart... I do get a little anemic sometimes, but with milady around, there's nothing to worry about."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Eternity and the Clockwork Doll
Some believe Roxy only remains by the head of the household's side to sustain her Porcelloy Heart: Flint Workshop used their bloodline to secure a capable assistant.
Roxy has heard such claims so often that she no longer even bothers refuting them. The other person concerned, however, can't help but worry over it.
One day, during a brief lull in her busy schedule, she casually brought the matter up with her assistant, only to be met with a helpless sigh.
"No, I've never thought of it that way. Just being alive is already more than enough. I've always been grateful to you, milady."
"Besides... if I may be so bold, aren't you the one bound by bloodline here, milady?"
"So this is what's been making you restless lately... Rather than some pointless rumor, I'd say that oversized Porcelloy order you boasted to the CCD about not long ago is far more worth worrying about."

Rusty Cliff Corp. , typically shortened to just Rusty Cliff , is a Faction that appears in Zenless Zone Zero . They are a member of the TOPS Round Table, with their leader, Edmund , holding the "Copper Ring" of the Three Pacts. [ 1 ]

Overview [ ] 
Rusty Cliff, being another member of the TOPS Round Table, is one of the largest Corporations in New Eridu . At least some of their revenue is derived from the mining of special Ether Crystals via their subsidiary "Rusty Cliff Mining," [ 2 ] while they also have stakes in both the entertainment industry and the development of military technology. Overview [ ] 
Satellite are an uncommon kind of idol group, being made up entirely of Bangboo members. Despite their agency specifically looking for Bangboo idols, very few places actually allow such groups to perform, but shortly after 404 reopened, Cecilia reached out to the group after stumbling upon them by chance. They are noted as being a niche group with a small fanbase, but one that is particularly passionate about them. Said fans are primarily made up of Bangboo, but they have some human fans, including Moe of The Forecasters .

Core Passive: Flower Chain Protocol 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
The Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's Vanguard .
When the Vanguard unleashes an EX Special Attack , Seed gains Onslaught status, increasing Seed's ATK by X and CRIT DMG by X% . When Seed unleashes an EX Special Attack , the Vanguard gains Direct Strike status, increasing the Vanguard' s ATK by X and CRIT DMG by X% .
When Direct Strike and Onslaught are both active, Seed and the Vanguard simultaneously gain Besiege status, increasing DMG dealt by X% .
Onslaught , Direct Strike , and Besiege buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a Vanguard , Seed immediately gains Onslaught status and Besiege status, while the Vanguard immediately gains Direct Strike status and Besiege status.
Direct Strike and Onslaught status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the Vanguard consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of Steel Charge .

01
"Hibernation Period"
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."
When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100.
The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100.
Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate .
Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.
02
"Light Absorption Technique"
This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"
When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF.
When activating EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals , after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed.
For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals , the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter' s DMG increases by 5%.
03
"A Story of Sprouting"
This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
"Fragrant Tune"
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."
When Seed's Besiege status buff is active, her Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%, and Ultimate DMG increases by 20%.
05
"Time to Bloom"
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
"Theory of the Heart"
Here lies a vast sea of flowers, blooming wild and brilliant.
She remembers how this place once looked — barren, without even a single blade of grass.
Who could have done such mischief? Who transformed this desolate, gloomy Hollow Zero into this? Who planted such a strong heart in this pale soil?
"So you've come such a long way on this circle..."
"Until we meet again, Seed Sr."
Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
When using Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter , fires 3 additional laser beams, each dealing 165% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s.

Toggle Text 
01
Heroism
When it comes to team missions, Seth is always leading the charge.
"Let me handle the arrests! I scored a 99 in close-quarters arrests, and the only point deducted was because I accidentally sprained the instructor's wrist."
The shield value provided by Shield of Firm Resolve and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When Shield of Firm Resolve ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by Core Passive: Protector lasts an additional 10s.
02
Recklessness of Youth
Many criminals make the mistake of underestimating Seth.
It might be his pure, clear eyes or those innocent-looking furry ears and tail. Whatever the reason, everyone who underestimates him eventually pays the price.
Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% Resolve . Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified increases the move's accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 35%.
03
Slow Reflexes
"A skilled officer like you must handle everything on your own, right? No help from others, surely?"
Even after hearing this, Seth remained composed and didn't say a word.
It wasn't until midnight that he suddenly woke up: "Could that guy's comment earlier... have been a dig at me?"
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Core Aspiration
"Put aside your foolish notions of good and evil. You can't protect everyone. Sometimes, you have to make a choice."
"This is my choice, and it's the core responsibility of an officer — you're the one who has changed, Brother."
The Daze caused by Defensive Assist: Thundershield is increased by 25%.
05
Distant Admiration
Seth used to deeply admire and respect his older brother. But as you know, "admiration" is the furthest thing from "understanding."
"Someday, I'll become the finest officer... and make him eat his words!"
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Idealist
To a young person, everything is clear-cut, with a stark contrast between black and white, right and wrong.
There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?
When Seth lands a finishing strike on an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified , it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a CRIT, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.

Long, Long Ago
Long, long ago, Lady Sunbringer lifted the very first handful of soil that would become this sky island...
Alright, alright. The children have already heard the story of Lady Sunbringer creating Roscaelifer's first island a thousand times over.

Legend's First Act
She was Roscaelifer's first soldier, its first spear. She stood on the first front line against the Hollows and led the very first charge.
She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands, she raised Roscaelifer's very first wall.
She was Roscaelifer's first blade broken. Her family name was de L'Azur.

Protector of Miracles
Roscaelifer is the miracle of the skies, and the title of those who protect that miracle has never belonged to only a select few.
Yet someone must lead those guardians. That was originally Lady Lindverne's duty, but with her bright and carefree nature, she was hardly suited to be a commanding general.
Fortunately, she had a dashing deputy. More accurately, she had one after another.

Hero in Training

Because of that, everyone expected the young de L'Azur to surpass the last, proving worthy of the legendary guardian family's name.
And so Lindverne continued weaving new, even more groundbreaking legends for Sigrid.
Each time upon gaining Aerial Patrol Spear , DMG dealt increases by 18% for 8 s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8 s, up to a maximum of 40 s.

Skybound Oath
Today, Lady Sunbringer commands countless followers through her reputation as a Void Hunter alone. But every renowned leader once stood with no one behind them.
To follow that young leader into the skies and build a miracle city that should never have been possible required either a brute's courage or a fool's innocence.
And each time a new de L'Azur recites that oath to conquer the skies, those two qualities shine brilliantly once more.

Tutorial [ ] 
A Singularity Leakage is a high-risk spatial anomaly that appears around the Scamall Hollow. It is caused by the Hollow's proximity, which results in extremely high concentrations of free Ether in the surrounding environment. When Ether becomes locally overconcentrated, it distorts the laws of space, creating an overlapping dimension that temporarily intersects with part of the Hollow's interior.
In the past, such singularities were rare and posed limited danger due to the Hollow's relatively stable activity. However, with the awakening of "The Creator," the Hollow's activity has intensified, causing Singularity Leakages to appear more frequently and with greater danger, now evolving into violent spatial anomalies capable of consuming life and threatening regional safety.

Mindscape Cinema [ ] 
Each Mindscape awakening requires Agent Focus: Soldier 11 ×1 .
Toggle Text 
01
Rapid Heat
Long-term high-intensity combat training allows Soldier 11 to complete mastery of her regulatory systems.
She will always strive to ensure that she's in the best shape for each and every battle.
When Soldier 11 enters combat or switches in, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.
02
Scorching Convergence
"She may look cold and hard, like a big ice cube... But actually, she's scalding hot, like a blazing fire."
— From an anonymous soldier of the Obsidian Division
When triggering Fire Suppression, Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.
03
Elite Soldier
Soldier 11 always expects the most from herself, no matter if it's in training or physical combat. That is how she maintains her combat prowess.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Indulgent Blaze
She envies fire. And these smoldering flames will always help her.
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's Basic Attack or a Dash Attack, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation.
If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.
05
Perfect Soldier
The road from elite to exemplar is long and difficult, but Solider 11 grits her teeth and perseveres, as if there's something pushing her towards the goal of becoming a perfect soldier...
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Scorching Flow
The flames of the sword distorted the air with their heat. Her movements grew ever more impassioned, as if that heat seeped into her spirit with every breath, igniting her thoughts.
When Soldier 11 uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks).
When Fire Suppression is triggered, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, causing the current move to ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES .

Toggle Text 
01
Uplifting Current
When charged, the special charging module can generate a wind current of Ether energy to charge surrounding Ether devices.
To Soukaku, it's just like having a buffet with friends.
"Guys~ It's all-you-can-eat time!"
When Soukaku triggers Core Passive: Blade Banner or Additional Ability: Group Set Meal, the buff duration is increased by 8s.
02
Experimental Charging Module
A charging module is able to continuously accumulate energy during battle.
Therefore, it is regarded as an era-defining conceptual tactical weapon by the R&D department.
But for Soukaku, fully charging it simply means it's time to eat.
When Soukaku's Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second.
When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.
03
Attendance Meal Allowance
The best way to motivate Soukaku to train harder is simple: just increase her attendance meal allowance.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Hypothermia
The custom-made weapon Oni Banner features a powerful built-in cooling system. Its Ether-infused catalyst generates cold air, dealing significant DMG to enemies it hits.
If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.
05
Late-Night Snacks
To further incentivize Soukaku to train is simple: just add a late-night snack top of the attendance meal allowance.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Northern Wind
Unlocking the safety device within the blade banner allows it to operate at full capacity. It's not just for combat... it's also handy for cooling down a meal.
While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks are increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.

"Tales of a hundred demons. Endless mysteries await"
— Welcome to the Spook Shack!
The Spook Shack is a Faction in Zenless Zone Zero . 
Unlike most other factions, Spook Shack is not an organized group or company. It is an Inter-Knot forum dedicated to sharing and solving supernatural mysteries and unexplained phenomena. The forum has no entry requirements, and most of its members are online friends who share common interests. Notably, Ukinami Yuzuha , a member of the forum herself, leads her own party of the Spook Shack in Waifei Peninsula , with Alice Thymefield noted as the newest forum member, who joins the faction by the end of the commission The Impending Crash of Waves in Phaethon's Story .

[Intel] The death of Bringer 
On a starry night, just beyond the Companion Hollow near Port Elpis ...
After losing his Carrot, Inspector Bringer led his few remaining subordinates through countless failed attempts and detours before finally finding a way out.
Shaken and disheveled, the Public Security officers looked back — behind them, the relentless Ethereals still roared and clawed at the edge of the Hollow, desperately trying to tear through, but to no avail.
They embraced one another in relief, grateful to have survived.
But then...
A massive hand suddenly reached out from the Hollow—
In a single instant, sharp claws pierced straight through Bringer's chest!
So whose claws ended the life of the " Janus Quarter Commander Candidate"?
Were they from an Ethereal capable of crossing over... or a traitor disguised as one?
Or something even more terrifying?
What lies behind this tragedy — an Ether-woven nightmare, or the corruption of humanity consumed by ambition?
For more details, check out the Spook Shack forum information board.

[Intel] Digging Deep Into Ancient Legends of Waifei Peninsula While Failume Heights Is Hot 
Yo, friends! Recently, Failume Heights has been back in the spotlight thanks to the rising exposure of our new Void Hunter , Ye Shunguang . Our archaeology squad at the Spook Shack , always chasing the latest buzz—I mean, pursuing historical truth—has dug up some ancient tales about the Waifei Peninsula.
You won't believe what we found! Today, let's talk about the legendary Yunkui Summit and the even more legendary Qingming Sword —how did they really come to be?
First up, let's talk about that mysterious Qingming Sword!
About this blade, I've got a mind-blowing conclusion: Based on cross-referencing multiple damaged ancient texts, the Qingming Sword wasn't originally from Yunkui Summit at all.
Legend has it that its prototype was some bizarre object of unknown material discovered near the Lemnian Hollow . But its true nature was terrifying—it actively drained the Ether from any human who touched it!
According to the records, every ordinary person who tried to touch or study it couldn't handle the agony of having their Ether instantly drained, and ultimately... turned to ash. This caused massive panic at the time.
Next up is the establishment of Yunkui Summit.
Just when the Qingming Sword was about to cause an even bigger disaster, a wandering master appeared. The ancient texts don't record his name, only that he possessed an extraordinary control over Ether Energy that no ordinary person could match.
Using his own power, he forcefully suppressed this deadly artifact and calmed the chaos. But even he couldn't completely destroy it. After trying every method without finding a way to eliminate it, this master made a reluctant decision...
On a remote mountain, using his lifetime of knowledge and some special techniques, he forcibly forged this deadly object into the form of a sword to contain and seal its power.
This sword became what we know as the Qingming Sword. And that mountain became Yunkui Summit.
Looking at it another way, while this master couldn't completely solve the problem, his teachings lived on. His philosophy of helping others and the profound cultivation methods he left behind—like the healing arts we can still see today, and those mysterious techniques for communicating with birds and beasts—made Yunkui Summit a respected power in the region for a long time.
Finally, the most mysterious and mystifying of all the collected legends has to be an ancient prophecy that came with the Qingming Sword.
We found similar recordings of this prophecy in several different versions of ancient texts—it must be the one passed down through generations at Yunkui Summit!
The prophecy has two parts:
1: "When darkness shrouds this land, all things wither, and songs of sorrow fall silent, only Bai Ze wielding the Qingming blade can break through the long night and awaken the dawn."
2: "The path of Bai Ze is never walked alone. When fate shifts, shadow follows light. Blessing and curse, joy and grief — one thought leads to heaven, the next... to the abyss."
"Bai Ze" clearly refers to the savior who can wield the Qingming Sword—no doubt about that. But what exactly are the "shifts of fate"? With all this talk of "shadow follows" and "blessing and curse," doesn't it seem like the "shifts of fate" might be even more crucial than the "Bai Ze" itself?
We haven't reached any conclusions about this question yet. What do you all think? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below!
Trivia [ ] 
The Spook Shack's logo could be referencing the logo of the American comedy franchise Ghostbusters , consisting of a prohibition sign over a ghost-like creature.
Each of Spook Shack's members' motifs appears to be a reference to mythological creatures:
Yuzuha and Kamanosuke are a reference to Bake-danuki ( Japanese : 化け狸 "The shape-shifting raccoon dog" ), a type of yōkai known for their mischievous tendencies.
Through not mythological in sense, Alice might be inspired by the White Rabbit , a character from Alice in Wonderland , hence her name. However, her connection with the Thiren species may be inspired by the Moon rabbit , a mythological figure from East Asian and indigenous American folklore, who is portrayed as a companion of the Chinese moon goddess, Chang'e .
Manato is inspired by Komainu ( Japanese : 狛犬 "The lion dog" ), the Japanese guardian lion dogs for the Shinto Shrines, and Ara Mitama from Shinto.
Lucia might be inspired by Fauns .
Yidhari is inspired by Kraken and Cthulhu Mythos .

Core Passive: Knight's Resolve 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All Physical DMG Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press to consume HP and activate Special Attack: Drive Suppression . While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by 45% for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains Determination when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. Determination regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie , activating Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger , or triggering a block restores additional Determination . Triggering a Perfect Dodge by any means restores 3 Determination . This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When Determination is greater than or equal to 100, hold to consume 100 Determination and activate Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight .
Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Knight's Technique restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter: Duel King activated through a Perfect Dodge restores HP. Using EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels or EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork restores HP.

"Loneliness Corruption Symptoms"
It didn't matter if no one understood her. As long as she had music, that was enough. It didn't matter if no one ever talked to her first, either. She'd never expected them to anyway...
Being surrounded by people made her so nervous that she fled the world, using delusions to fill the empty space it left behind. She was the master of her own tiny realm, setting up "keep out" warnings at the edges, then painting everything bright with music.
"I'm not like them. I—I'm a lonely genius!"
She puffed out her cheeks and quietly wiped away the lonely tear that slipped from the corner of her eye.

"That kid's an odd one, always humming strange songs alone in the corner..."
Having heard such remarks all her life, she stopped hoping for any other kind of judgment.
Then, one warm and gentle afternoon, a dark-haired girl stretched her hand out like an angel.
Ah... so she had always been seeking this sense of being understood. Always... waiting for someone she could call a friend.
Even having grown accustomed to loneliness from endless practice, humans are still, in the end, social animals. That person lifted her out of damp, clinging solitude, and from then on, she had a shelter made of feathers.

She has never before received praise from so many strangers.
"Those gentle songs gave me strength."
"Finding music I could resonate with at my saddest moment was so moving..."
"This style of music is so cute!!"
The girl stares nervously at the screen. The small red dot marking new messages quivers along with her heartbeat, as she opens the same window over and over again—
Just a little more... just a few more people seeing my music... a few more people seeing me, someone who's good for nothing but writing music...
All I want is for a few more people to take power from this.

From being dragged out the door by Nangong to signing her name on that contract... to the girl, the entire day passed as swiftly as a flash of summer lightning cutting through a rainy night.
Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.

She imagined that somewhere in the vast galaxy, someone was driving a clattering electric tram, setting off from pale morning light and heading straight toward infinity.

Leaving behind the rush of everyday life, stepping away from mundane routines—
"If I could borrow the wings of the Angels of Delusion, maybe I could bring everyone into a world of music like this!"
Surrounded by the sugary aroma of a scented candle, she stretched with a soft yawn, then wrote this romantic dream onto the sheet music.

Overview [ ] 
In its sealed form, it is briefly depicted as being shielded by two white wings, with a long blade positioned at its center, all radiating a bright white glow. Thaumiel's true form is a pair of four mechanical, razor-sharp wings with the bottom half being smaller with four mechanical feathers, and the top half being bigger with boosters in each of the wings that function similarly to a jetpack, while also containing two swords in the metacarpus of the larger wings.
The Karma Core sealed within Thaumiel holds the power to halt the flow of time, thus granting Remielle the power of controlling temporal patterns at any duration. [ 1 ] Due to partially fusing with the Karma Core, Remielle can replicate a similar effect on a smaller scale without Thaumiel to reduce Ether activity in both people and monsters to nigh zero, effectively petrifying them. This power manifests as a feather that rests upon those affected, causing them to become pale white in colour. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] 
History [ ] 
Thaumiel is the personal weapon of Remielle Dan , one of the first generation Void Hunters . She wielded it as her signature weapon, most notably using it to push back the Dark Wall by thirty-seven kilometers. At some point, however, Thaumiel was discarded by Remielle for unknown reasons. It was later hidden within a colorless region of the Hollow , sealed inside a white container, which can be only unlocked by a special item like the Flint Porcelloy W-Engine as a "key."
In recent times, TOPS launched a search for the weapon. The area containing it was eventually discovered by Phaethon , Billy , Cissia , and Promeia . While in a trance, Phaethon approached the container and placed their hand upon it, triggering its release. Upon being freed, Thaumiel merged with Phaethon's body, transforming them into a powerful Ethereal known as the Scorched Horizon .
Although Billy, Cissia, and Promeia attempted to subdue them, they were quickly overwhelmed, and Promeia was nearly killed when Phaethon emerges from the Scorched Horizon's remains in their Ethereal-esque form . However, Remielle ultimately arrived in time to intervene, reverting Phaethon to normal by seemingly extracting Thaumiel from their body and reclaiming it. [ 3 ]

Etymology [ ] 
"Thaumiel" originates from the Qliphoth in Jewish mysticism. The name is commonly interpreted as "Twin Gods" or "Twins of God," derived from the "ta'om" ( Hebrew : תאום "twin" ), and is associated with duality and opposition.
This is likely a nod to Remielle Dan's two outfits which contrast with each other.

Overview [ ] 
The Forecasters are a musical group managed by Mr. Ooda.
The group consists of Maki, the Lead Vocalist, Nana, and Moe, the composer, who is the most junior member.
Prior to starting The Forecasters, Maki and Nana were together in another group, before Maki was headhunted by a major agency to be in the idol group known as Venus , which caused the original group to be disbanded. 
Although Venus ended up becoming wildly popular, Maki eventually left, wanting to join back up with Nana, with Venus breaking up as a result.
Maki considers The Forecasters to be a "sister group" to the Angels of Delusion , with many parallels being able to be drawn between the members of the 2 groups.

title: Timeline
text:
This page has lacking info that may be provided in the future.
The content on this page is currently dynamic and is subject to information revealed in future stories, such as Phaethon's Story , Agent Story , and Commissions . As a result, some information may be missing or outdated. Can you help out? Click here to add more. Last updated: August 7, 2026 (During Version 3.1 ) 
Timeline
Type
Historical Events 
Lore 
Time periods are assumed based on the fact that "Swordmaster" was alive during the founding of Eridu as the third-generation head of the Hoshimi family, while Miyabi is the daughter of the tenth-generation head of the Hoshimi family. We assume each generation lasted around 20 years.
A very rough estimation of the timeline of the Zenless Zone Zero universe, incorporating historical records, dialogues, and hearsay. A constant work in progress; take information given with a grain of salt. Since time is progressing in-game, with the Fall of the Old Capital happening 10 years prior in 1.0 but 11 years prior in 2.0, [ 1 ] the years will be updated accordingly.
References are provided as much as possible. Notes expand on the deduction and reasoning used to draw certain conclusions, which can be read either by hovering over (desktop-only) or clicking on the note. Some specific types of notes found on the page:
Lore Discrepancy: When information provided in the game is self-contradictory, retroactively changed, or contradicts information from outside media (such as HoYoLAB posts or YouTube videos), it is considered a lore discrepancy. This is different from a translation discrepancy, in which information is contradictory or misleading due to inaccuracies in localization. In the case of a lore discrepancy between in-game information and outside media, the in-game information always takes priority.
Translation Note: Used when the original Chinese text and then official English localization do not match, or if something is clearer in Chinese. In the case of a translation discrepancy, the original Chinese text always takes priority.
Assumptions: To make sense of the lore — which the miHoYo writers often deliberately obscure by withholding critical information until later versions, giving contradictory evidence, and scattering information across various item sets — editors will sometimes make assumptions to determine the order of events or connect pieces of lore together. However, they may be obsoleted and proven incorrect by new lore and story. These notes serve as a disclaimer, and expand on the editors' reasoning for their conclusions.
If you have any proposed changes for the timeline, please leave a comment and cite your evidence.

Qingyi was created. [ 2 ] [ 3 ]

Banyue was created. [ 5 ] [ Lore Discrepancy 1 ]

Hollows started appearing after a great war took place. [ Note 1 ]

First Hollow Disaster.
Eridu Era [ ] 
From ~140 years ago to 11 years ago
Over 100 years ago [ ] 
The church of the Exaltists was created. [ Assumption 2 ] 
Karma Cores from various Enchainers that had been collected, were used to create powerful weapons, becoming known as the Void Hunter Weapons .
The city of Eridu was founded thanks to the efforts of the seven Void Hunters : [ 6 ] 
Vike , Dan and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe repelled the Black Wall 37 km back. [ 6 ] 
"Sunbringer" , the CEO of Marcel Group, destroyed the "Hive Lord" Hollow in the sky, and created the Bangboo . [ 6 ] 
"Swordmaster" took down the Exaltist Overseer, [ 6 ] wielding Tailless . [ Assumption 3 ] 
"Joyous" , Ace of Investigation Guild, navigated the Divine Maze, setting the start of hollow investigation and concept of Proxies . [ 6 ] [ 7 ] 
Professor Arche discovered the common characteristics of Hollows. [ 6 ] 
Around 100 years ago [ ] 
Arche and Sunbringer devise "Project Sunseeker", an experiment that aimed to fuse the Void Hunters with the Karma Cores inside their weapons. [ 8 ] 
Both Beliora Vike and Remielle Dan became corrupted by this process, beginning their transformation into new Enchainers.
Due to the severe corruption and transformation she underwent, Beliora Vike ended up being slain by Remielle Dan.
Although also corrupted, due to the effects of Thaumiel , Remielle did not fully transform, instead ending up locked inside temporal stasis for 100 years.
Roscaelifer was founded by Sunbringer, being the utopia of the Bangboo. [ 9 ] 
The mystics sect of Yunkui Summit was founded. [ Assumption 4 ] 
Helios Academy was founded by Professor Arche. [ 6 ] 
The first " Tour de Inferno " took place in the Outer Ring . [ 10 ] 
42 years ago until The Fall [ ] 
Operated by Helios Academy, Omond Flint creates the Omond Research Station inside the Papago Hollow .
Leisha Christie worked at the White Waves Hospital as a maternity nurse. [ 11 ] 
Billy Kid was found by Appon and his mentor inside the Lost Tech Ruins, sold to Caesar 's Father, named, and taken is as a member of the biker gang Calydon. [ 4 ] [ 12 ] 
After a failed operation, Banyue was left abandoned inside Lemnian Hollow . [ 13 ] 
Part of Fairy 's operational data was temporarily activated without a formal agreement, so that she could command a unit of A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct - Mirage Archer Units , including Aria. [ 14 ] 
Belobog Heavy Industries was founded by Khors Belobog . [ 15 ] 
During a Hollow expedition, the parents of Grace Howard , both researchers, disappeared and were presumed deceased [ 16 ] 
Grace Howard was later adopted by Khors Belobog, her parents' friend, who raised her as a daughter. [ 16 ] 
Anton Ivanov joined Belobog Heavy Industries. [ 17 ] 
Khors Belobog started working on "The Prototype" and showed it to his young daughter Koleda Belobog [ 18 ] 
Ben Bigger joined Belobog Heavy Industries as a frontline mechanical operator. [ 19 ] 
Banyue was found by a "sage" [ 13 ] from Marcel Group , [ 20 ] who rewrote the programming within his Core to function like a Logic Core.
Justin Bringer was promoted from being a frontline officer to being an Inspector and commanding officer in General Chop 's precinct. [ 21 ] 
Inspector Bringer took part in a mission inside a Hollow, where he gave up his own anti-corruption equipment to save as many civilians as possible, including a child named Zhu Yuan . [ Assumption 5 ] While he was succumbing to corruption and his wounds, he happened to witness an Exaltist "miracle", which later converted him to the cause, and granted him the Creator's healing. [ 22 ] His miraculous return granted him the title of "Hollow Hero". [ 21 ] 
Following his impressive feat as the Hollow Hero, Inspector Bringer was later transferred to the Public Security Headquarters in Janus Quarter. [ 21 ] 
Banyue was retrieved from the Hollow by Ning Shu , who brought him back to Failume Heights . [ 23 ] 
The two street-roaming orphan sisters Yijiang and Yixuan were taken in by the eleventh-generation High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit. [ 24 ] 
Because of his Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome, Asaba Harumasa was abandoned by his parents at the best hospital in the city before he even learned how to talk properly. [ 25 ] He was then taken in by his master, a doctor member of a "power player"-backed research [ 26 ] on Ether Aptitude-boosting drugs.
Harumasa was taught by his master how to draw a bow and wield a blade, among other life skills. [ 25 ] 
Harumasa's master grew fond of Harumasa, secretly switching his reasearch to find a cure to Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome instead. When the investors found out, and his master refused to perform the final experiment on Harumasa, they made him disappear inside a Hollow, letting him corrupt into a Thracian . [ 26 ] 
Wise and Belle were taken in by Carole Arna at the Helios Academy. [ 27 ]

Assumptions [ ] 
↑ Although little is known about The Creator's origins, given their power over Hollows, and the fact that the Enchainers are said to be "rulers of the Great Hollows," it can be reasonably theorized that The Creator (in this form) was "born" around the same time that the Hollows themselves started appearing. 
↑ Given how the cult rotates around humanity evolving into the Age of Hollows, it is expected it was founded after Hollows appeared, and even more so after people had the stability and means to research how to reach the refinement. 
↑ Both Chapter 5 and the "Behind the Agent" post mention "Tailless" to have been property of the Hoshimi family since their first generation. Moreover, the voices inside the katana call Miyabi "the second most arrogant person we've met," implying that Swordmaster was the first. 
↑ Since Yixuan is the thirteenth-generation High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit, with Yijiang before her as the twelfth and their Shifu as the eleventh, and assuming the generations before the Fall of the Old Capital lasted at least 20 years each, Yunkui Summit should have been founded around the same time as Eridu. 
↑ We assume that Zhu Yuan was saved in the same instance of Bringer becoming a hero, as it is the only mission Bringer carried-out in a Hollow that has been mentioned. In the commission after General Chop narrates the Hollow Hero story, Zhu Yuan also mentions how Bringer gave her his own protective gear (which is incredibly dangerous and mirrors the narration in the cassette where he says he gave up his anti-corruption equipment). 
↑ Given how Hugo was sold as a child, yet is seemingly a teenager at least in the comic-book panels of Chapter 3 after joining Lycaon and Jack, it can be reasonably assumed that his sale to the Ravenlocks happened prior to the fall. 
↑ Based on the fact that Lycaon is recruited by New Eridu Mayor Mayflower after Hugo's suspected betrayal, it can reasonably be assumed that the original Mockingbird was formed around the Fall of the Old Capital. 
↑ It's the original Phaethon account that messaged Vivian, yet the account was already somewhat well-known at this point. A logical conclusion is that the interaction with Vivian happened after the account was made, but before Phaethon became a Legendary Proxy. 
↑ It is unclear exactly how long Nicole has known the siblings personally, however given her vast amount of debt with the duo, it is clear she has been using Phaethon's services for some time. 
↑ Given that Komano Manato himself says he was around 8 years old at the time of the Fall 11 years ago, he is around 19 at present time. It would be reasonable to assume that he was at least mid-teens when he adopted the orphans. 
↑ It is stated by both Shepherd and Venus that rising through the different Proxy ranks takes an incredibly long time and that there are seldom few "Legendary Proxies", however Wise and Belle got there exceptionally fast, mostly due to their usage of Eous and the HDD. It is still unclear whether they were "Legendary Proxies" before or after they got to know Nicole. 
↑ Given how Soukaku was not present at the H.S.O.S.6 foundation, how little she was when Yanagi took her in, and how slow the Oni growing process is said to be, Soukaku's joining has to be very recent. 
Lore Discrepancies [ ] 
↑ Banyue's Agent Intel 1 states that he was developed by TOPS , however the ZTALK video states that he is an Old Civilization construct. Although possible that TOPS have existed since that time, there is no in-game information that currently supports this. It is also possible that the usage of "developed" was to suggest that TOPS did not initially create him, however it is unclear. 
↑ There is a discrepancy, or misuse of language, between what is stated during This Night Is Gilded , and the Enemy Intel for A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct - Mirage Archer Unit . The latter, which is a quote from Banyue, states that this model of construct is "old-era", which is a term used to denote Old Civilization, however during the story segment "About the Wishing Sprite", Fairy states that these models were created by a certain group during the time of the Old Capital, with Fairy being the commander of Aria's unit. 
↑ This information clashes from Yixuan's statement "And I, was the last surviving disciple of Yunkui Summit." Given how Ju Fufu's Agent Intel entry in Chinese 结合修者组织云岿山档案所记录之日期， 可以推测 橘福福在旧都陷落时期即已拜入现任云岿山领袖仪玄门下 marks her status as a disciple from before the Fall as an assumption, we are inclined to believe Yixuan's statement more. This does not take away from the fact she is Yixuan's first disciple.

Basic Attack: Silenced Shot 
Basic Attack 
Hold to activate:
Trigger enters the Sniper Stance and fires forward continuously, dealing Electric DMG .
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the stick/joystick to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a Perfect Dodge , followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing , Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit Sniper Stance .
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 Purge , up to a maximum of 100 Purge .
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. A Quick Assist can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.
