Toggle Text 
01
Sharpened Senses
Hearing that can distinguish every subtle change in the wind, touch that can sense every tremor in the ground. To compensate for her visual limitations, the young lady honed her other senses to perfection.
"Being a sniper is the only thing I excel at... At least in this, I refuse to lose to anyone."
The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze is increased by an additional 20%.
When activating Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot , the cooldown is reduced to 2s.
Purge gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in Sniper Stance increases by 25%. Maximum Purge increases to 125.
02
"Ether Vision"
When inside the Hollow, every Ether fluctuation around her becomes an aid to her spatial observation.
"I used to think these eyes were cursed, bringing nothing but pain."
"But now... they're my ticket to reaching my goals, and proof that I haven't forgotten my past."
Upon using an Aftershock , Trigger gains 1 stack of Hunter's Gaze .
When executing a Finishing Move in Sniper Stance , Trigger gains 2 stacks of Hunter's Gaze .
Each stack of Hunter's Gaze increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
03
"Homecoming"
The home she could return to is now sealed away in the past.
Her cold lips pressed against the harmonica, the lonely melody the only testament to her memories.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Concealment
Footsteps, breaths, heartbeats. She smothers every trace of her own aura until her entire form blends seamlessly with the environment. She moves through the battlefield like a ghostly reaper.
Outside of combat though, this silent way of moving has been strictly forbidden after scaring her teammates one too many times.
Of course, she definitely hasn't been using these stealth tactics to observe the video store when she can't find an opportunity to meet someone there... right?
When Trigger enters or extends Coordinated Support , while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot or Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus , it will trigger Disconnect upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact.
This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.
05
Locked In
Once a target is locked, even with a broken, decaying body or through excruciating pain, never let your crosshair waver. From the targets of her revenge to those she must protect, from enemies to allies — this is the will of a sniper.
But with the Proxy, the one who gave her light in her darkest hour, it's not about locking in but being drawn in. Even if there's no reason to keep watching, she will never divert her aim — this is the will of a young lady.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Beyond the River of the Dead
"You know what? Those who are stained with blood in battle can only go to the underworld after death."
"Beyond the river of the dead lies a sight of unparalleled beauty. Flowers bloom all around me, while familiar faces from my past accompany me to my final, peaceful place of rest."
"But... because of you, because I have something to protect, perhaps I don't want that day to come so soon."
Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 Armor Break Rounds .
For every 25 Purge consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional Armor Break Round , up to a maximum of 5 rounds.
While possessing Armor Break Rounds , when Trigger hits a target in Sniper Stance , 1 Armor Break Round is consumed to deal additional Electric DMG equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK.
In addition, this instance of DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.

Toggle Text 
01
Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy
"Having the clarity to see your enemy's weakness is like an extra safety net... and it increasing your chances at victory."
Yanagi adjusts her glasses, remaining as composed as ever, even when victory is already assured.
When any squad member inflicts an Anomaly on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of Clarity , lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy attack, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of Clarity to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of Clarity , her Anomaly Proficiency increases by 80.
02
Outstanding Adaptability
"Yanagi can handle any unfamiliar environment thrown her way."
"I believe in her more than I believe in myself."
— From a martial artist practicing "the cutting of fallen leaves."
During her EX Special Attack , the rapid thrust's Electric Anomaly Buildup increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers Polarity Disorder , the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original Disorder effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.
03
Tsukishiro Style Management
Everyone says Section 6 is gathering oddballs and geniuses, with Tsukishiro Yanagi being the only "normal" one. But it’s precisely her presence that holds the oddballs and geniuses together.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Chessmaster
No matter the situation, Tsukishiro Yanagi can rapidly grasp all the information at hand and make the most appropriate decision.
When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomaly DMG on an enemy, they suffer the Exposed effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the Expose effect will have 16% increased PEN Ratio.
05
"Other Mother"
At present, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the sole designated guardian of Soukaku.
"Soukaku, this is the Chief's riceball, you mustn't eat it... forget it, come here, I'll heat it up for you."
"We'll just buy a similar one for the Chief later."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Inhuman Blood
Flowing through Tsukishiro Yanagi's veins is blood that isn’t entirely her own. This blood once granted her new life in the face of despair, and with it, she gained certain special powers.
"But as you know, something that isn't mine... comes with a price."
After a thrust attack during her EX Special Attack , the duration of the Shinrabanshou state increases to 30s. While the state is active, Yanagi's ATK increases by 15%, and her EX Special Attack DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for Polarity Disorder in Outstanding Adaptability can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.

Dreams of a Fading Winter
The day the TOPS executives and the Inspection Team arrived, she and Manato had just returned from school. Their airship had to circle overhead for ages, waiting for a place to land because the guests' vehicles took priority. Sweating as they hurried across the skybridge, they passed just above a throng of reporters surrounding the guests. That's when she spotted the girl. That night, she had a dream: it was her being swarmed by reporters, walking that same path under the bridge. And at the end of it... stood a throne, waiting just for her.
It had been a long time since she'd had a dream like that. She got up for a drink of water, replaying the words she'd overheard during the day: "A so-called expert Inspection Team, and they've got some rich girl tagging along just for show!"
"Kama, Kama!" She cracked open the window and whispered. A fuzzy little face popped up instantly from outside. "I've got a great idea. Tomorrow night... let's go do something fun."

Core Passive 
When Velina's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, every additional 0.01 increases DMG dealt by 0.21%, up to a maximum increase of 35%, and increases Anomaly Mastery by 0.5, up to a maximum increase of 84.
When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 Windbloom. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. Using EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise or EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow grants 45 Windbloom Windbloom When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 points of Windbloom . Using EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise or EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow grants 45 points of Windbloom , up to a maximum of 135 points. With enough Windbloom , hold or to launch EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm . , up to a maximum of 135 Windbloom . 
When Velina triggers Vortex , she gains 1 point of Windbite Windbite When Velina triggers Vortex , she gains 1 point of Windbite . When Velina has 2 points of Windbite , the next time she triggers Vortex , she consumes 2 points of Windbite to increase that instance's DMG Multiplier. and summons a Condensed Cyclone Condensed Cyclone When Velina triggers Vortex , she summons a Condensed Cyclone that deals Wind DMG . When the Condensed Cyclone dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy afflicted with a Wind Anomaly , it deals one instance of Abloom DMG. , dealing Wind DMG . This effect can trigger once every 3s. When Velina has 2 points of Windbite , the next time she triggers Vortex , 2 points of Windbite are consumed to increase that Vortex' s DMG Multiplier by X% . In addition, a Sweeping Cyclone Sweeping Cyclone When Velina uses EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm or triggers Vortex while consuming 2 points of Windbite, she summons a Sweeping Cyclone to continuously deal Wind DMG that is capable of triggering the Chromatic Tint effect. When Sweeping Cyclone attacks hit enemies, the enemy's Wind Anomaly Buildup RES and the corresponding Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES from Chromatic Tint are reduced. When Sweeping Cyclone dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy suffering a Wind Anomaly , it deals one instance of Abloom DMG. is summoned instead of a Condensed Cyclone , which does not grant Windbite .
When Velina's summoned Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy suffering Contamination for the first time, it triggers Chromatic Tint Windbite When Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy afflicted with Contamination for the first time, it triggers the Chromatic Tint effect, converting into a Sweeping Cyclone of the corresponding attribute and dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. , converting it into a Sweeping Cyclone of the corresponding attribute, dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. When Sweeping Cyclone hits an enemy, the enemy's Wind Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If a Sweeping Cyclone enhanced by Chromatic Tint hits an enemy, the enemy's corresponding Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES is also reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Toggle Text 
01
Orderly Elegance
Every word and gesture is placed precisely where it belongs.
Before the other party even realizes it, they willingly accept the boundaries, rhythm, and outcome she has arranged—
"Elegance is simply the most natural expression of order in motion."
Sweeping Cyclone from Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette deals an additional 20% Daze.
When Velina triggers Vortex , she ignores 20% of the target's All-Attribute RES . When squad members deal Windswept DMG, 20% of the target's Wind RES is ignored.
02
Saturation Project
She anticipates every possibility, accounts for every variable, and makes backup plans for things going wrong.
She never relies on chance. Every ending is calculated.
Even if the situation veers off course for a moment, it only leads onto another path she has already prepared for.
"Sigh, so it's come to this... Good thing I'm not entirely unprepared."
When Velina triggers Windswept , she can also gain 1 point of Windbite . This effect can trigger once every 5s.
After Sweeping Cyclone triggers the Chromatic Tint effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations.
The DMG increase effects of Velina's Windswept and Vortex from Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette are further increased by 15%.
03
Conquest by Etiquette
No need to force submission through strength, nor rely on emotion or intimidation.
A graceful response and a carefully measured compromise are enough...
Before anyone realizes it, the situation has already been steered toward destined conquest.
"Is etiquette simply violence in disguise?"
"Or is etiquette the more refined form of violence?"
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Tea Party Tribunal
In the midst of laughter and conversation, the scales have already tipped.
The tea has yet to go cold, yet the verdict is already sold.
"If something's bothering me, I'll simply deal with it and move on. And if someone's bothering me, heh..."
When Velina uses an EX Special Attack , her ATK increases by 15% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
05
Death Witch
"Her footsteps herald judgment!"
"Her invitation is your funeral!"
The silver-haired witch sits calmly beneath the theater of the Bangboo Kingdom, listening to the tiny performers hurl accusations at her with absolute conviction. She gently waves her ornate fan, smiling without a word.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Chief Angel
"There is no need to ask an angel's name. She hides within rumors, behind reprimands, and within the fearful letters requesting aid you deliver with shaking hands."
When Velina consumes 2 points of Windbite to increase the DMG Multiplier of Vortex , she gains 1 point of Windbite . This effect can trigger once every 6s.
When Velina hits an enemy suffering a Wind Attribute Anomaly , the Wind Attribute Anomaly Buildup she inflicts increases by 20%.
When Velina inflicts Windswept on an enemy already affected by Windswept , the new Windswept 's DMG increases based on the remaining duration of the previous. Each remaining second increases the DMG by 2.5%, up to a maximum increase of 40%.

Description [ ] 
" Void Hunter " - the highest official honor in New Eridu , bestowed personally by the mayor upon heroes who achieve extraordinary feats in combating the Hollow Disaster.
However, in the city's shadows, a more ancient and forbidden term closely tied to the "Void Hunter" title circulates among the few who know—" Void Hunter Weapons ."
Carole Arna once mentioned there seems to be some kind of unavoidable "price" behind every weapon.
This theory has found preliminary confirmation in two known items believed to be "Void Hunter weapons."
Qingming Sword : The sacred treasure of Yunkui Summit . Its user, Ye Shunguang , while gaining immense power, suffers from irreversible backlash effects including memory loss and sensory deterioration.
Ethereal-Slaying Katana - Tailless : The current Void Hunter Hoshimi Miyabi 's blade. Reportedly, earning this blade's recognition comes at a tremendous cost, and prolonged use will gradually corrupt its wielder.
A mysterious high-ranking official of the Krampus Compliance Authority once mentioned the term "Void Hunter Weapons" during an internal discussion, linking it to a certain organization's secret plans.
This suggests that Void Hunter Weapons are not merely individual armaments, but may be tied to complex power plays and struggles among New Eridu's upper echelons.
Is the title of "Void Hunter" genuinely just an "honor," and nothing else?
Are these so-called "Void Hunter Weapons" truly meant to combat the Hollows, or do they themselves share a deeper, more dangerous connection to the Hollows' secrets?
The truth continues to lie buried in the darkest depths.
Tutorial, Ridu Encyclopedia: Void Hunter's Weapons 
Overview [ ] 
Coined as an official term by Carole Arna, it refers to the ancient weapons that were forged using the power of the Hollows , and that thus can grant the wielder the might of a Void Hunter. According to her, the Void Hunter Weapons have a "price" the wielder must pay behind them, proven by the great toll Tailless and the Qingming Sword respectively took on the Hoshimi Family and Yunkui Summit throughout the generations. [ 1 ] They are currently sought after by TOPS . [ 2 ] 
It would later be revealed that the Void Hunter Weapons were created using Flint Porcelloy to seal within them the Karma Cores : the cores of the Enchainers who serve as The Creator 's most powerful agents. The price invoked by each weapon will cause their user to transform in to an Enchainer after prolonged usage. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] As the Void Hunter weapons and the Creator share the same origin, the side effects of the weapons are able to be lifted by the Creator's power, and the weapons can kill the Creator. [ 5 ] [ 6 ]

Void Hunter is a prestigious title that has been awarded by the mayor of the city since the founding of the original Eridu . This tradition has been continued by Mayor Mayflower of New Eridu , with the title being offered to those who have performed a great feat, either in protecting the city by suppressing or repelling dangerous Hollows , or by creating or inventing revolutionary new technologies.

Overview [ ] 
At the time of the foundation of Eridu, there were seven people who served to become the first and original Void Hunters.
While it is public that Hoshimi Miyabi and Ye Shunguang are the New Eridu era Void Hunters, and the same is for the general feats of the original seven Void Hunters, further information about the group is locked behind Inter-Knot 's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6 "The City Defenders". [ 1 ] 
As per the agreement between the Void Hunters, anything involving the Dark Wall must be reported before any further proceedings. [ 2 ] 
It is hinted that there is more to the Void Hunter role than just the title, with the Mayor's monologue implying he has an ulterior motive for gathering Void Hunter Weapons Keepers like Ye Shunguang. [ 3 ] 
In-Game Descriptions [ ] 
Hoshimi Miyabi [ ] 
In the old capital under the gaze of the moon, seven travelers of the World's Void once made a decision:
to allow the king of the mortal realm to bestow honors upon them.
To this day, most of the new capital's seven badges lie forgotten, gathering dust,
a fact known to few, while the joyous city remains confident in her impenetrable protection.
The Ethereal-hunting foxfire has been tamed by the martial artist,
and young fox ears flicker frequently on fluorescent screens,
filling people with boundless confidence.
Yet those seated atop the pinnacle of the new capital are restless, each harboring their own fears.
Ye Shunguang [ ] 
The Void Hunters represent the highest honor and strongest force in all of New Eridu.
The mayor will bestow each of them a unique title before their name.
This title not only commends and represents their irreplaceable and impressive feats, but also immortalizes the resolve unique to each Void Hunter.
As for Ye Shunguang, her title is the "Qingming Arbiter."
This symbolizes the fact that Ye Shunguang is no longer constrained by, nor is a victim of, the Qingming Sword, but rather its master and is able to harness its power.
It not only cements the fact that Ye Shunguang holds dominion over the Qingming Sword, but also serves as a reminder to all that behind this honor lies an unrelentless and ongoing sacrifice.
Every time she slashes her sword, the sands of her memories silently fall.
Every time she shields another, her senses gradually fade.
This is the Qingming Arbiter of New Eridu.
She is no divine being, yet she holds unimaginable strength. Consequently, she also bears a burden so heavy that it stirs the heavens.
Thus, when you see the blinding flash of her sword streaking through the night, never forget:
That light represents the young lady's devotion and protection through self-sacrifice.
Remielle Dan [ ] 
In the ancient capital beneath the Moon's gaze, six souls once committed the folly of overreach.
They slew Their Messenger and seized the authority They had bestowed.
Some say they forged it into an eternal mark of glory.
Some say they branded it into a sacrificial seal.
...
Rumors swirl, but the truth has long since faded from memory.
Perhaps it is for this very reason that she has returned from a stillness stretching a hundred years.
Perhaps what she seeks is the answer from a century past... the answer no one knows.

Core Skill 
Core Passive 
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack , or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack , the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by X% .
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt , Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack , or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist , Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz . If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6% .
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate , Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz , the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack , Dodge , Dash Attack , and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack , Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his Basic Attack .
When the active character performs a Dodge or Dodge Counter , Lycaon will simultaneously perform a Dodge or Dodge Counter . After performing a Dodge Counter while in the Encircle Prey state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack .
While the Encircle Prey state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the Encircle Prey duration does not decrease.

Core Passive: Burning Clarity 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
When not in the Enlightened Mind state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build Qingming Sword Force . Whenever Qingming Sword Force is gained by any means, each 1 point of Qingming Sword Force that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of Bearer Bearer Gain 1 Qingming Sword Force per stack when exiting Enlightened Mind , stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the Enlightened Mind state, all Bearer stacks are consumed to grant the same number of Qingming Sword Force stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity , increasing CRIT Rate by X% and DMG by Y% .
When Ultimate: Chasing Storms or Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict . Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind . The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG .
While Ether Veil: Verdict is active, when an enemy enters Ether Veil: Verdict , they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when Ether Veil: Verdict ends.

Toggle Text 
01
Dreambound Self
Countless times, in the dead of night, she finds herself returning to that day...
Steel cried out, the sword acknowledged its wielder, and a contract was forged.
Was it a blessing, or a curse?
...No one knows the answer. Yet from that day on, her fate became bound to the sword.
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force . This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.
02
Light & Shadow
Time flowed on, winters giving way to summers.
Her entire world amounted to this tiny stretch of Yunkui Summit, the changing seasons of the mountain were all she would ever see.
In endless solitude and ever-present fear, "another self" quietly came into being.
"...I am a part of her. From beginning to end, we were never apart."
"If she is the light, then I am the shadow. If she stands as a lofty idol, then I am the mortal who crawls below."
"Unlike her, I have no wish to become some kind of 'hero'..."
"...I just want to survive."
The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times.
While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination .
EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens' s DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
03
Swordswoman
A peerless famed sword lies hidden deep in the mountains, its edge fully restrained.
But once unsheathed, its icy light reaches far and wide, even after storms of wind and snow, a single piercing light endures.
"What is someone who wields a blade?"
"Nothing more than... the courage to press forward without hesitation, and the resolve to cut through anything."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Together into the Dust
Hidden beneath a grand vision was a lie, where salvation came only by burning oneself to ash.
Fate showed her no mercy, yet she willingly met her end.
"I understand."
"I will live my whole life alongside 'loss'."
"I willingly accept everything..."
"...This is the person I choose to be."
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.
05
Guiding Glimmer
"...I suppose, in the end, I'm still that 'lucky' child."
"Miasma won't overwhelm me, disaster won't swallow me."
"Even the Qingming Sword can't drag me into that pitch-black, bottomless abyss..."
"My brother, Shifu, everyone at Suibian Temple... and you."
"...I know you'll all keep waiting for me."
And so, even if the road ahead is filled with thorns, a faint light still guides the way.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Lantern Wish
Once, she stood alone, walking through the dark.
Then she took up her sword and rushed toward disaster. As Qingming left its sheath, a fleeting arc of light split the sky, illuminating that silent, shadowed land.
"...I want to be one light among countless fireflies."
"The sun will rise. No matter how long the night lasts, dawn always comes."
"In the distant past, and in the distant future, there must be countless others who made the same choice as me. We... were never alone."
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish .
When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish , stacking up to 4 times.
With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish , EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens . When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish .
The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG .

The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.

05
This Solace Is Real
"Such beautiful eyes... am I still inside a dream?"
It was their first meeting, and her first brush with something real.
Amid the emptiness and the grotesque, in the barren abyss that threatened to devour everything, she caught sight of those eyes.
They were like a hint of green breaking through the burning desert, like a clear spring rising from a parched riverbed.
"I think I've found it... the hope of someone who will willingly respond to me."
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
At Last, a Peaceful Dream
Immersed in the tide of memories, she had never found even fleeting rest.
Her only refuge was solitude, escaping the bustle of the world, losing herself in strange tales, seeking quiet beneath veils of misty rain or within the embrace of warm waters.
But now, she can walk calmly among the crowds, no longer troubled by noise or the burning sun, for "illusion" no longer binds her spirit, and "reality" has become the anchor of her soul.
After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend Ether Veil: Wellspring , she gains Erudition for 30s.
While Erudition is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.

EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation 
Special Attack 
EX Special Attack 
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold to activate:
Charge continuously, and release to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG .
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array .
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

Core Passive 
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Auric Ink DMG Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup , it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by X% .
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

Spiritual Path

Yunkui Summit is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero . They were founded by a powerful master with incredible control over Ether , who thus could continue his legacy and guarantee that the evil power within the Qingming Sword could be kept at bay. Their philosophy is saving and helping people, and their cultivation techniques, focused on Ether manipulation, include transposition, weapon control, disease mitigation and communication with animals. Trivia [ ] 
The design of the faction members is inspired from Chinese Taoism .
Etymology [ ] 
Yun ( Chinese : 雲 ) in the name means "cloud", and Kui ( Chinese : 巋 ) means "when hills align" or "steadfastly stands like an alp".
The name could be also from a poem, 雲中寺 "A Temple in the Cloud" , by a Song Dynasty poet, Zicheng Liu ( Chinese : 劉子澄 ).
The first couplet of the poem is 地辟層 雲巋 古禪，我來訪古尚依然 "(This is a isolated place, with clouds layering and the temple standing still , I come here to visit this ancient site and it remains unchanged)" .

Basic Attack: Final Verdict 
Basic Attack 
Hold to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG .
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict , Chain Attack , or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals X% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil , if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist . If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist , Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Core Passive: Ideal Colleague 
Core Skill 
Core Passive 
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining X% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points . This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points . This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill .
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill , all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring .
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring .
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring , all squad members' ATK increase by Y for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

01
Righteous Verdict
"Don't let that cute face fool you! I'll never forget that meeting — right there in front of a few dozen people, she pointed her finger and, with the sweetest expression, delivered the coldest verdict: 'If your company refuses any single item in this rectification list, you will be removed from TOPS. This isn't a threat — it's the objectively correct conclusion.' That image is forever etched in my mind! ...Still, I have to thank Miss Zhao."
—A company manager who revived his business after a brutal restructuring, speaking with a conflicted look as he rubbed his temples.
When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.
02
Krampus Senior
Xiao'Zhao joined Krampus very early on, and even within the elite of the elite, the Krampus Compliance Authority, she's still addressed as "senior." That's how it should be... if only the juniors who came after weren't all the type who value personality over protocol.
When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
03
Frostveil Edge
Xiao'Zhao's weapon, "Frostveil," is an experimental asset supplied through a confidential TOPS research project. Rather than merely projecting Ice-aligned Ether into strikes, the weapon channels Ether into its own structure. Under normal conditions, Frostveil is only half the weight of comparable weapons, but once in combat, its rapidly condensed ice edge gains far greater destructive power. The design might as well have been tailor-made for Xiao'Zhao.

04
Featherlight Footsteps
Agile, light, and hard to pin down. Words once used to describe a little rabbit are now being used to describe a terrifying warrior wielding a massive blade, capable of cutting through anything...
When Zhao activates an Ether Veil , she gains 250 Decibels.
The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate , Chain Attack , and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.
05
Fuzzy Listener
If Xiao'Zhao's ears twitch unconsciously and perk up slightly, it means she's heard that which matters to her most. It could be intel, a mission, a deal... or praise.
Basic Attack , Dodge , Assist , Special Attack , and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
No Value Has Its Own Value
The wall of beliefs she'd built since childhood, molded by so many people, has begun to crack because of one encounter.
Xiao'Zhao now sees value differently: when something carries no listed price, it isn't useless, it's simply too precious for anything to stand as its equivalent.
The CRIT Rate buff from Core Passive: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value.
The extra DMG gained from charging during Basic Attack: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.

Mindscape Cinema [ ] 
Each Mindscape awakening requires Agent Focus: Zhu Yuan ×1 .
Toggle Text 
01
Quick Reload
Zhu Yuan once competed in the Janus Quarter's Public Security Officer Contest, clinching first place with her extraordinary reloading techniques. her colleage commented: "It's nothing but sheer practice."
When Zhu Yuan activates a Chain Attack/Ultimate, she gains the Quick Reload effect.
When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.
02
Ether Ember
Zhu Yuan is equipped with Ether bullets specially designed by Public Security, which cause irreversible corruption upon hitting the enemy. This is why Zhu Yuan always warns her enemies to surrender and stop resisting before she fires. It really is for their own health and safety...
In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan's Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%.
When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, the target takes 10% more Ether DMG from Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s.
Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
03
Public Security Special Training
As an elite Public Security Officer, Zhu Yuan's training focused on a single objective: to enhance all aspects of her combat abilities within the Hollow, ensuring she could outmatch any criminal
Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
04
Ether Perforation
When in battle, the gangs in the Hollows often try to quietly calculate how many bullets their enemies have left. What they don't know is that Zhu Yuan's custom magazine can recharge itself with the Ether in the air...
When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target's Ether RES .
05
Special Ops Experience
A seasoned Public Security Officer excels at reading the battlefield, striking precisely and maximizing combat efficiency. Sometimes, one stern look is enough to make her enemies think twice about putting up a fight.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
06
Expanded Energy Pack III
﻿Zhu Yuan often worries about her gear's remaining battery, getting nervous when the power dips into the red zone and consciously saving power. Public Security finally equipped her with an energy pack that offered both high capacity and long-lasting endurance.
When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next EX Special Attack is reduced by 30.
Launching an EX Special Attack will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot.
Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.

title: Armorer
text:
Armorer
Type
Combat 
Game Systems 
Agents with the Armorer specialty pack serious offensive power, and
excel at dealing massive DMG through Maim and Laceration.
Loading Screen 
Armorer is one of the Specialties in Zenless Zone Zero . Agents with the Armorer specialty excel at accumulating Gash to apply Maim, dealing massive damage, while balancing offense and defense by scaling their damage off of DEF rather than ATK. They charge their EX Special Attacks with Sharpness instead of Energy . Rather than benefiting from CRIT DMG , their Sharp DMG triggers Laceration DMG Bonus on a CRIT. Should CRIT Rate exceed 100%, the excess can trigger an additional Laceration check, applying an extra instance of Laceration DMG Bonus if successful.

title: Attack Type
text:
See also: Specialty and Attribute 
Attack Type
Type
Combat 
Game Systems 
Attack Type , previously called Fighting Style and rarely referred to as Hit Type , is a descriptor that indicates how an Agent performs their attacks.
Contents
1 Details 
2 Attack Types 
2.1 Slash 
2.2 Strike 
2.3 Pierce 
3 Other Languages 
3.1 Attack Type 
3.2 Slash 
3.3 Strike 
3.4 Pierce 
4 Change History 
5 Navigation 
Details [ ] 
During the first beta period for Zenless Zone Zero , Version 0.13 , Attack Type was the main metric for telling a player how an Agent would perform in battle, as Specialties did not exist at the time. During this version, an Agent's Attack Type would dictate how much Daze (then called "Stagger") they would deal to an enemy, with each attack type working better against a specific Enemy type:
Slash countered Ethereals .
Strike countered Machines .
Pierce countered Organics .
In Version 0.3.0 , Specialties would be released, replacing Attack Type as the main combat-performance metric; however, Attack Types remained in the game, albeit with very sparse information as to what they entailed or if they affected combat in any meaningful way.
Attack Types [ ] 
Slash [ ] 
The Agent specializes in dealing damage with Slash attacks.
These Agents fight using bladed melee weapons that can hit from close to mid-range. Some Agents with this Attack Type can deflect enemy projectiles in combat when dashing .

title: Bundle Shop
text:

Bundle Shop  Bundle Shop
Type
Shops 
Monetization 
The Bundle Shop is a Shop where players can purchase bundles of items such as Master Tape , Encrypted Master Tape , and Denny , for real-world money or Monochrome .
The majority of the bundles that can be purchased for real-world money are a one-time purchase per account, while most bundles that can be purchased for Monochrome can only be purchased in limited quantities each week or month. Some bundles are special, in that they can only be purchased during a specific Version , or for a short period after hitting specific progression milestones, after which they will be removed from the store.
